Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

As part of LIST's SUSTAIN unit (Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity), the Environmental Policies (EPS) group provides science-based input to the definition and implementation of environmental policies at national and EU level, in particular policies around chemical safety, soil pollution, circular (bio-)economy (e.g. construction, textile, water), and climate - and feeds, at the interface of science, technologies and policies, the regulatory perspective into RDI projects around these topics.

As postdoc (R&T Scientist), you will further strengthen the activities around soil health and the management of contaminated sites via contributing to:
• The further development (implementation-phase) of an Urban Soil Living Lab in Luxembourg (Horizon Europe project URSOILL - Innovative Solutions for Sustainable Urban Soil Restoration Through Living Labs) and participation in a working group on soil remediation and stabilization with nature-based solutions, especially phytoremediation and phytomanagement. Main tasks: literature review; design of field experiments and monitoring protocols across multiple urban sites; support and supervision of fieldwork; data analysis and interpretation; stakeholder engagement in the Living Lab; and scientific publications and project deliverables.
• The establishment of a cross-border network of ‘Lighthouses' of phytomanagement for soil remediation, biodiversity and the regenerative economy in the Greater Region (Interreg project Light4Green),
• Scientific and regulatory support, e.g. via bibliography and the preparation of a review article, on nature-based remediation solutions for Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) contamination (Interreg project Naturem),
• The set-up of a laboratory for testing and evaluating soil remediation technologies (especially bioremediation and phytoremediation),
• Support the definition, submission and implementation of research and collaborative project proposals of the group, and participate to the network of LIST's different activities around soil protection.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
Education

• You hold a Master's degree and a PhD in soil or environmental sciences/engineering, or another relevant natural science or engineering domain.
• You have practical and solid experience in the design, testing, evaluation and application of nature-based soil remediation technologies, e.g. phytoremediation, bioremediation, mycoremediation.
• Interdisciplinary thinking, well-developed communication skills (oral and written) and team spirit to successfully integrate into the multicultural, multilingual and multidisciplinary work environment at LIST and effectively communicate with LIST's partners,

o First experience in an RTO/academic environment, scientific/technical consulting, authorities, or industry on contaminated site management, pollution risk assessment or remediation

Language skills

• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages, especially French, German, or Luxembourgish are a strong asset.

XXXX-112 Senior Data Steward - Subsidy Projects
Luxembourg - Esch-sur-Alzette
Full-time
Fixed-term
69,000 - 77,000 € per year

Who we are

XXXX (XXXX) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. XXXX enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The XXXX service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, XXXX will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.

www.XXXX.lu | XXXX on LinkedIn

Purpose of the job / project

Ready to play a key role in shaping the future of health data access and trusted data sharing in Luxembourg and beyond?
Join our team and contribute to strategic national and European initiatives that advance secure, compliant, and efficient access to data for research, innovation, and public policy. You will support flagship projects such as but not limited to, HDAB2-LU, which is enabling the establishment of the Luxembourg Health Data Access Body and laying the foundations for a robust health data ecosystem aligned with European data-sharing frameworks.

As a Senior Data Steward, you will contribute to the development of data governance practices, data access services, and project-related solutions that facilitate secure data sharing, strengthen health and research data ecosystems, and promote the responsible adoption of trustworthy AI. Your work will directly contribute to XXXX's mission of unlocking the value of data while ensuring transparency, compliance, and public trust.

As a Senior Data Steward, you will drive the development and delivery of the data access request management capacity. This includes the collection and validation of access conditions from different data providers, standardising the information into data request application form, defining the access review procedure and SOPs, compiling requirements of data access management tools, supporting the implementation of the tools to and implementing the data access request management workflows in the tools. You will work with the other project team members from XXXX, including Project Coordinator, Work Package Leaders, Data Protection Officer (DPO) and ethical, legal and societal implications (ELSI) experts to implement the required compliance measures related to the projects. Finally, you will interact with the information security, technology, and data teams to ensure adequate design and delivery of services.

• Develop and deliver XXXX' DM/DS services within the scope of the projects
• Contribute to other services and the maintenance of XXXX' DM/DS toolbox.
• Develop guidelines on data management, stewardship and protection for the projects
• Contribute to the XXXX' Data Catalogue by populating, curating, and updating metadata related to data custodians, provenance and use restrictions for datasets of the projects
• Implement necessary General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) accountability measures for data processing activities involving personal data required by the projects
• Perform Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) for data processing activities concerning sensitive data for the projects
• Provide training on DM/DS best practices, tools, and related to the DS services of the projects
• Develop internal processes and guidelines to support relevant information security and data protection compliances and certifications related to the projects
• Engage in (inter-)national projects related to DM/DS service development related to the projects
• Train and supervise less experienced team members working on the projects

• MSc or PhD in natural science or technology, or social science with technical skills.
• 5 to 10 years of relevant experience, including relevant ones in the following areas:
          - data stewardship
          - data management
          - community coordination, outreach and training.
• Working knowledge in data lifecycle management, FAIR data principles (Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability, and Reuse) and the GDPR
• Experience in technical writing (white papers, documentation, reports, policies) and content for dissemination to stakeholders and the public (online guides, tutorials)
• Good working knowledge of one programming language (Python or R)
• Good working knowledge of command line shell (any OS)
• Good working knowledge of basic website authoring (markdown, jinja, HTML)
• Proven experience in one of the following topics:
          - Ethical, legal and societal implications in data-driven research projects
          - Designing and implementing organisational risk management processes
          - Data requests management of sensitive data
          - DPIA
         - Community building and management
• Excellent verbal communication skills in English.
• Service and collaborative attitude
• Ability and willingness to interact closely with stakeholders
• Ability to handle multiple assignments while working independently and effectively under deadlines

About us

What we offer

• Dynamic and innovative work environment
• Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
• Inclusive and diverse culture
• European recognition and impactful projects
• Shape the future of the data revolution

What sets us apart
The XXXX is a modern and dynamic undertaking. We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission. We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies. Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character. Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values. We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.  
Join XXXX and revolutionise the data economy!
Be part of our dynamic team driving innovation and making a tangible impact. Collaborate on cutting-edge projects, gaining European recognition in the prestigious European Data Spaces initiative. Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.

title: Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer (m/f)
description:
Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer to join to the internal Finance department.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

Position Summary

The Cash Management & Credit Risk Officer is responsible for optimizing the Company's cash flow by managing accounts receivable, reducing credit risk, improving collection performance, and supporting treasury activities. The role combines operational cash collection, credit risk management, reporting, business partnering, legal recovery coordination, and continuous process improvement.

What will you do?

Cash Collection & Accounts Receivable

• Manage customer accounts, handle accounts receivable, and ensure the timely collection of outstanding invoices.
• Coordinate reminder campaigns and follow up on payment commitments.
• Escalate overdue cases in line with the Cash Recovery Policy.
• Negotiate payment arrangements and coordinate legal recovery when required.
• Resolve payment issues in collaboration with Partners, Project Managers and client teams.

Credit Risk Management

• Implement a client credit rating system.
• Maintain and update client and group risk ratings.
• Monitor payment behaviour, financial exposure and insolvency indicators.
• Recommend credit terms, collection strategies and risk mitigation actions.
• Monitor customer insolvency risks, in particular by conducting checks with the Luxembourg Commercial Register (LBR).

Cash Management & Reporting

• Produce dashboards and KPI reports (DSO, ageing, cash collection, risk ratings, exposure, legal recovery and forecast accuracy).
• Contribute to the preparation of PowerBI reports.
• Present analyses and recommendations to Management and the Cash Recovery Committee.

Business Partnering

• Advise Partners and business teams on receivable management and credit risk.
• Promote timely billing, proactive collections and effective dispute resolution.
• Ensure compliance with the Company's Cash Recovery Policy and applicable legislation.

Process Improvement & Governance

• Continuously improve collection processes, reporting, workflows and internal controls.
• Contribute to the digitization of processes, particularly through AI.
• Maintain the Cash Recovery Policy, credit procedures and risk models.
• Coordinate with Partners, Treasury, Finance and external legal advisors.

Shared Service Center Coordination

• Act as the primary liaison between Luxembourg and the AR Team in Morocco.
• Occasional travels to Morocco to strengthen collaboration, monitor performance, deliver training and ensure consistent application of Finance procedures.

This position is for you if:

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent.
• Minimum 7 years' experience in Accounts Receivable, Credit Control or Cash Management.
• Experience in a professional services environment is an asset.
• Team management.

Technical Skills

• Strong accounting and credit management knowledge.
• Advanced Excel skills; IA, Power BI and ERP experience are an advantage.
• Knowledge of Luxembourg accounting and VAT principles.

Personal Skills

• Analytical and results-oriented.
• Strong negotiation and communication skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management.
• Organized, proactive and detail-oriented.
• Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to build collaborative relationships across teams and cultures.

Languages

• English and French required.
• German and/or Luxembourgish are considered assets.
…then this offer is probably made for you!


What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

title: Senior infrastructure Engineer (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Description:


How will you contribute?

You will support the operation and continuous improvement of LIST's Linux infrastructure (including user endpoints and IT services), ensuring reliable, secure and efficient environments for research and organizational activities.

Working within the IT Infrastructure team, you will:

·          Administer, maintain and continuously improve LIST's backup, storage and file-service infrastructure.
·          Operate the Commvault backup platform, including policies, schedules, retention, reporting and capacity management.
·          Monitor backup jobs, perform recovery tests, and support disaster-recovery and business-continuity procedures.
·          Administer storage infrastructure and file services supporting SMB shares, VMware and other infrastructure workloads.
·          Manage storage capacity, performance, availability, resilience, data protection and lifecycle activities.
·          Monitor infrastructure hardware and services, including servers, storage, virtualization, backup and network-related components.
·          Maintain relevant monitoring dashboards, alerting rules, service indicators, thresholds and operational reports.
·          Investigate and troubleshoot incidents, failures, alerts, performance issues, capacity constraints and hardware problems.
·          Perform or coordinate upgrades, patching, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, replacements and decommissioning.
·          Contribute to capacity planning, performance optimization, service continuity and infrastructure architecture improvements.
·          Maintain accurate technical documentation covering configurations, procedures, dependencies, recovery requirements and escalation paths.



Additional infrastructure responsibilities:

Under the guidance of IT Infrastructure colleagues, you will also provide support for:

·          Active Directory operations, including user and computer administration, group management, access control and directory hygiene.
·          Telephony and unified-communications services, including operational support, maintenance, lifecycle activities and service improvements.

You will collaborate closely with IT Operations, Information Security, Applications and Development teams, researchers, external service providers and other stakeholders to ensure secure, reliable and efficient IT services


Project delivery and activity management:

In addition to day-to-day engineering and operational support, you will contribute to IT and infrastructure projects delivered through internal initiatives and in collaboration with external partners or clients.
You will manage your activities in accordance with LIST's project-management methodology by planning and prioritizing tasks, estimating effort, tracking progress, managing dependencies and risks, coordinating stakeholders and delivering agreed outcomes. Depending on the assignment, you may also coordinate or manage IT or LIST-level projects involving multidisciplinary teams.


Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!


Education:

·          Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field experience


Experience and skills:

·          Minimum of 5–7 years of professional experience in infrastructure operations, systems administration or a comparable IT environment.

·          Experience administering or supporting enterprise storage systems, file services and storage technologies for virtualisation or infrastructure workloads.
·          Experience with infrastructure monitoring, including service availability, hardware health, capacity, performance and alert management.

·          Experience with VMware or comparable virtualisation technologies is an advantage.
·          Experience operating or supporting enterprise telephony, unified communications or related services is an advantage.
·          Good understanding of infrastructure-security practices, including hardening, access control, vulnerability remediation, encryption and data protection.
·          Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP and firewalls.
·          Experience with scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, Ansible or equivalent is an advantage.
·          Experience supporting cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS is an advantage.
·          Ability to work in accordance with internal IT policies, security requirements and operational standards.
·          Experience using project-management and collaboration tools such as Asana, Jira, Microsoft Planner or equivalent.


Soft skills:

·          Strong analytical, diagnostic, and troubleshooting abilities
·          Collaborative and service-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
·          Project-oriented and delivery-focused mindset, including the ability to plan, prioritize, coordinate and report on activities.
·          Strong documentation, communication, planning and organizational skills.
·          Proactive approach and willingness to continuously improve infrastructure reliability, security, efficiency and user experience.
·          Ability to prioritize tasks and respond effectively to incidents and operational requirements.
·          Ability to explain technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
·          Ability to work independently while recognizing when to seek guidance or involve specialist colleagues.


Language skills:

•               Fluency in English (Luxembourgish, German and especially French are considered as an asset), both oral and written.


Your LIST benefits:

·          An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
·          Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
·          Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do

·          Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
·          Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
·          Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science

Apply online

req1167

• Contribute to knowledge sharing and training initiatives within Institutional Banking by supporting colleagues and continuously developing specialized expertise.
• Act as an ambassador of the BIL Group through participation in conferences, presentations, training sessions and industry events, while maintaining a strong professional network.

title: Lower School Teaching Assistant (Gr2 Classrooms) 6-months contract (m/f)
description:
Lower School Teaching Assistant (Gr2 Classrooms) 6-months contract

We're delighted that you're considering joining our learning community at ISL. As you consider this opportunity, we kindly ask that you apply only if you can join us on the stated start date and will be fully free from any existing contractual or notice-period obligations by that time. We appreciate your understanding.

The role?
At ISL, we believe our young learners are capable, curious and full of ideas. They learn through relationships, play, inquiry and meaningful exploration of the world around them. We are seeking a Lower School Classroom Teaching Assistant to assist our Grade 2 teachers (students ages 7-8) in creating caring, inclusive environments where every student feels a sense of belonging, develops agency and independence, and experiences the joy of learning.

Working in partnership with the classroom teacher and wider Lower School team, the Teaching Assistant is an important resource for students and parents.

What will you do?

Working alongside the Grade 2 classroom teachers, you will:

• help create a caring and inquiry-rich learning environment;
• support individuals and small groups during student-initiated and teacher-directed learning;
• encourage curiosity, communication, collaboration, creativity and problem-solving;
• observe and document students' learning and emerging needs;
• prepare materials and learning spaces that invite exploration;
• support arrival, dismissal, transitions, specialist lessons, lunch, playground and other daily routines;
• help children develop positive relationships, independence and a sense of responsibility; and
• supervise and accompany students during activities, field trips and other experiences beyond the classroom.

What skills do you bring?

We are interested in what you can do, how you work with others and your potential to learn and grow. Your skills may have been developed through education, employment, volunteering, or community activities.

You will be able to demonstrate your ability to:

• Build trusting relationships with young students, helping them feel safe, known and valued.
• Support learning through inquiry, using conversation, thoughtful questions and exploration to extend students' thinking.
• Notice and respond to learners, observing students and collaborating with the teachers to document learning and development.
• Foster agency and independence, knowing when to support, when to question and when to give students space to try for themselves.

title: Research Scientist in Economics of Sustainability (m/f)
description:
Description:


Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems
Job Number: UOL08508
Contract Type: Permanent
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Job Level: level 1
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Cluster
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist


Your role:

The successful candidate will establish internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems.
The candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.
A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.


Your profile:

The successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.
Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.
The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.


The ideal candidate will have:

• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 4 years Postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda
• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions
• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding
• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systems


Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English. The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance


How to apply:

Applications should contain:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable


All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.


General Information:

• Reference: UOL08508 (to be mentioned in all correspondence)
• Publication date: -
• Contract Type: Permanent
• Working Hours:  
• Location: Belval Campus
• Planned starting date: 01/11/2026


Gender equality:

In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, diversity and a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of everybody is respected. The University is committed to achieving gender parity among its academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

Sellers can list and sell their products across all of our European sites from a single account. description:
Description:


Executive Assistant


Pour l'un de nos clients, acteur bancaire de premier plan au Luxembourg, nous recherchons un(e) Executive Assistant & Business Management Support pour rejoindre l'environnement direct du CEO et de son Executive Office.


A PROPOS DU POSTE

Vous avez déjà acquis une première expérience solide dans un environnement exigeant, idéalement au sein d'un Big4, d'un cabinet de conseil, d'un cabinet d'avocats ou du secteur financier, et vous souhaitez aujourd'hui vous rapprocher du cœur des décisions d'une organisation ?

Cette opportunité va au-delà d'un poste classique d'Executive Assistant.

Aux côtés du CEO et de son environnement exécutif, vous combinez support de haut niveau, coordination, préparation de supports et suivi de sujets stratégiques et opérationnels.

Votre rôle : permettre au CEO d'être organisé, préparé et concentré sur ses priorités, tout en assurant un suivi rigoureux des informations, demandes et actions qui gravitent autour de l'Executive Office.

Il s'agit d'une fonction particulièrement intéressante pour un profil ayant environ 5 années d'expérience, souhaitant continuer à apprendre, gagner en exposition et évoluer progressivement vers des responsabilités plus larges de Business Management / Executive Office.


VOTRE RÔLE ET RESPONSABILITES:
Executive Support & organisation

Vous assurez un support quotidien fluide et structuré auprès du CEO et de son environnement exécutif :

    gestion proactive d'un agenda complexe et mouvant ;
    organisation et coordination des réunions internes et externes ;
    préparation des rendez-vous, agendas et documents nécessaires ;
    anticipation des échéances et identification des priorités ;
    coordination des déplacements professionnels et de leur logistique ;
    gestion des notes de frais, factures et autres sujets administratifs associés.

Vous ne vous contentez pas d'organiser : vous anticipez, identifiez les conflits de priorité et proposez des solutions.
Business Management & coordination

Une partie importante de votre rôle consiste à faciliter le fonctionnement de l'Executive Office.

À ce titre, vous :

    assurez le suivi des actions et décisions prises lors des réunions ;
    sollicitez les différentes parties prenantes afin d'obtenir les informations attendues ;
    consolidez des informations provenant de plusieurs interlocuteurs ;
    structurez ces éléments afin de les rendre immédiatement exploitables par le CEO ;
    maintenez des trackers et outils de suivi permettant de donner de la visibilité sur l'avancement des différents sujets ;
    contribuez à la coordination de projets et initiatives transverses ;
    identifiez les échéances ou sujets nécessitant une attention particulière et les faites remonter de manière proactive.

Votre capacité à comprendre rapidement un sujet, structurer l'information et assurer le suivi jusqu'à sa finalisation fera réellement la différence.
Executive Communication & préparation de supports

Vous contribuez directement à la qualité des informations et documents utilisés au niveau exécutif :

    préparation et mise en forme de présentations PowerPoint ;
    préparation de briefings, notes de synthèse et meeting packs ;
    consolidation de données et préparation de reportings simples sous Excel ;
    rédaction, relecture et adaptation de communications en français et en anglais ;
    préparation et organisation de documents destinés à des réunions de management ou de gouvernance.

Vous savez transformer une quantité importante d'informations en un support clair, synthétique et orienté décision.
Coordination & stakeholder management

Positionné(e) au cœur de l'organisation, vous êtes en interaction avec de nombreux interlocuteurs internes et externes.

Vous assurez une communication fluide et professionnelle, relancez lorsque nécessaire et savez adapter votre approche à des interlocuteurs de niveaux de séniorité différents.

La confidentialité, la diplomatie et la qualité de votre communication sont essentielles dans cette fonction.


Vous avez idéalement :

    un Bachelor ou Master en gestion, économie, management ou formation équivalente ;
    environ 5 années d'expérience professionnelle dans une fonction d'Executive Assistant, Business Support, PMO, Executive Office ou une fonction comparable ;
    une expérience acquise dans un Big4 ou un environnement de conseil/professional services exigeant, fortement appréciée ;
    l'habitude de travailler directement avec des Partners, Managing Directors, membres de direction ou autres senior executives ;
    une excellente maîtrise de PowerPoint, avec la capacité de produire des présentations professionnelles et structurées ;
    une bonne maîtrise d'Excel et des outils de suivi/reporting ;
    d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse ;
    une parfaite maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l'anglais ; le luxembourgeois constitue un atout.

Au-delà de votre expérience, nous recherchons surtout une personnalité.

Vous êtes structuré(e), fiable et extrêmement organisé(e), mais également curieux(se) et capable de comprendre ce qui se joue derrière une demande.

Vous savez travailler dans un environnement où les priorités peuvent changer rapidement, sans perdre en qualité ni en précision.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec des interlocuteurs seniors tout en conservant une posture professionnelle et naturelle.

Enfin, vous recherchez un poste dans lequel vous pourrez apprendre, prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités et développer une compréhension transverse du fonctionnement d'une banque et de son Executive Management.

title: RESEARCHER IN ATOMISTIC MODELLING OF FERROELECTRIC DYNAMICS (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
How will you contribute?
Get ready to dive into the captivating realm of ferroelectrics, where surprises at the nanoscale await discovery! We are thrilled to announce a unique opportunity for a curious and skilled Postdoctoral Researcher to join our dynamic team.
Ferroelectrics continue to mesmerize at the nanoscale. By inducing electrostatic or mechanic frustration on them, we can unlock a rich tapestry of dipole structures, including skyrmions and vortex lattices. Such polar textures are a hot research topic and offer a dual promise. First, their origin and behaviour pose intriguing questions begging for answers. Second, they hold great potential for groundbreaking applications, from outstanding voltage amplifications to shaping the future of 6G technologies.
In the realm of ferroelectric ultrathin films, we are facing new challenges. Applying an electric bias transforms the dipole landscape, giving rise to confined nanoregions (bubbles) with a polarization opposite to their embedding matrix. These bubbles are electric versions of magnetic skyrmions, and are more than just a rarity; they constitute a novel quasiparticle in their own right. Recent experimental observations and successful manipulation attempts have set the stage. Yet, their dynamical behaviour remains a largely unexplored frontier. Lately our group at LIST predicted that electric bubbles will display Brownian motion and that this motion can be harnessed to produce bubble currents.
We offer you a postdoc position in the project “Bubblaced”, led by Hugo Aramberri (hugo.aramberri@list.lu), and focused on the modelling of electric bubble quasiparticles. You will join the ongoing work by Hugo Aramberri and Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) on understanding these objects using second-principles atomistic simulation methods, focusing on their dynamics and possible ways to act on them. You will also benefit from interactions with other team members. Join us in exploring the fascinating world of electric bubbles!

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
• You hold a PhD in Condensed Matter Physics, Materials Science, Computational Physics, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
• You have hands-on experience with atomistic modelling (DFT, second-principles, machine-learned force fields), scripting for automation and data analysis (e.g. Python, Bash), and working in a Linux/HPC environment. Knowledge of ferroelectricity and/or molecular dynamics is a strong asset.

Language skills

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/
You will join the Environmental Health (EH) group within the Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit at LIST. SUSTAIN conducts cross-disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society, combining expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation.
The Environmental Health group conducts cutting-edge research at the intersection of environmental toxicology, human health, and regulatory science, integrating in vitro toxicology, systems toxicology, exposure science, and sustainability assessment to develop next-generation tools and methods that inform decision-making and support the development of safe and sustainable products and policies.
This PhD position is embedded in the AIM-PACE project, which aims at developing a new generation of safe-and-sustainable-by-design, bio-based and circular plastics by combining AI, microbial technology, computer modelling, and polymer science. The PhD candidate is expected to support the operationalisation of the Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) framework, actively contribute to the Safety Assessment of the novel bio-based polymers and the integration of results for informed decision making along the life-cycle and innovation routes. Production of chemical safety data, primarily generated through in vitro New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), and computational modelling are expected to be key outcomes. The PhD candidate will combine experimental toxicology with computational approaches and scientific literature data to validate relevant case studies, supporting the identification of methodological gaps and challenges, and contributing to the advancement of SSbD approaches for bio-based materials.
The PhD will be co-supervised by Dr. Ivana Vinkovic (Institute for Medical Research and Occupational Health, Zagreb), a leading international expert in safety and toxicology assessment of advanced materials. Her research group performs cutting edge research at the nano-bio interface to identify opportunities and risks of nanomaterials and advanced materials at early stage of development, in a multidisciplinary environment covering chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, toxicology, risk assessment and regulatory science. In addition, it operates a high-impact testing platform for more tailored risk assessment and decision making which based on advanced biochemistry, immunology, toxicology, molecular and cell biology facilities. The academic supervisor will provide scientific guidance and mentorship throughout the doctoral research, support the development of the research plan, monitor progress, facilitate integration within the academic environment, and ensure compliance with the requirements of the PhD programme. The Faculty of Science, University of Zagreb, is one of the leading research and higher education institutions in Croatia, offering advanced training and research infrastructure in chemistry, biochemistry, nanotechnology, biosensors, environmental health, and biomedical sciences. The host group has expertise in Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) approaches, nanomaterials, advanced analytical methods, and translational biomedical research.

As a PhD Student within the AIM-PACE project, your main responsibilities will include:
• Supporting the scoping analysis of the AIM-PACE scenarios and products, as part of the SSbD framework implementation.
• Conducting a comprehensive literature review and data collection on hazard profiles of existing substances/materials and use of computational modelling for data gap filling.
• Identifying, reviewing and using models and tools for hazard screening, exposure assessment and risk assessment in the context of SSbD.
• Application of new approach methodologies (NAMs), including in vitro and computational tools, for hazard, exposure and risk assessment of AIM-PACE materials.
• Collaborating with project partners in integrating safety output with sustainability, techno-economic and social indicators.
• Collaborating with the team of Dr. Ivana Vinkovic Vrček to explore research activities, scientific training, conferences, and dissemination activities, and complete all doctoral requirements according to University of Zagreb regulations.
• Contributing to the dissemination of results through peer-reviewed scientific publications, conference presentations, and technical reports.

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d). What if it was you?

In today's increasingly complex regulatory and financial environment, combating financial crime is a critical priority for all organisations. At our firm, the Financial Crime Compliance team acts as a strategic advisor to management and clients, proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks related to money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions breaches, fraud, and other financial crimes.

As a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in delivering expert guidance, designing robust compliance frameworks, and supporting clients in implementing effective controls to safeguard their operations and reputation.
Be a part of our team where you will:

Client Risk Assessment and Advisory

• Conduct comprehensive financial crime risk assessments, covering AML, sanctions, fraud, and bribery/corruption risks;
• Advise clients on regulatory requirements and best practices under Luxembourg law, EU directives, FATF recommendations, and global standards;

Customer Due Diligence and Enhanced Due Diligence

• Review and analyze KYC documentation for new clients during onboarding;
• Perform ongoing due diligence and periodic reviews of existing client files;
• Conduct reputational checks and adverse media screening on clients and beneficial owners.

Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

Sanctions and Screening Controls

• Implement and oversee sanctions screening processes, ensuring compliance with EU, UN, and OFAC lists;
• Review and validate screening results, investigate potential matches, and escalate confirmed hits;
• Advise clients on integrating sanctions screening tools and maintaining up-to-date watchlists.

Fraud and Bribery/Corruption Risk Management

• Assist clients in developing anti-fraud and anti-bribery policies and controls;
• Conduct fraud risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures;
• Support investigations into suspected fraud or corruption cases.

Monitoring, Reporting, and Regulatory Support

• Prepare compliance reports and dashboards for senior management and regulators;
• Support clients during regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring timely and accurate responses;
• Maintain and file confidential compliance documentation in accordance with legal requirements.

Training and Awareness

• Deliver training sessions on financial crime compliance, including AML, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery measures;
• Promote awareness of emerging risks, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.

Let's talk about you. If you have/are:

• Hold a university degree (minimum Bac+3) in Law, Finance, Compliance, or a related field;
• Have at least 3–5 years of experience in financial crime compliance, AML, or regulatory advisory within financial services or consulting;
• Possess strong knowledge of Luxembourg and EU financial crime regulations, FATF standards, and global compliance frameworks;
• Bring proven experience in transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud risk management, and investigations;
• Demonstrate excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex projects and multiple priorities;

description:

Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in IoT connectivity and next-generation satellite communication services. As a venture-backed company with a proven track record of satellite launches, we are the first in the world to integrate cellular 5G with satellites, enabling seamless connectivity for devices in remote and underserved regions. • Contribute to the research, development, and adaptation of L1/L2/L3 protocol stack components for Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) supporting NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies.
• Participate in the full R&D lifecycle, including system design, implementation, integration, testing, and performance optimization.
• Analyze, troubleshoot, and enhance protocol stack behavior across multiple layers, including PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, and NAS.
• Investigate and implement NTN-specific adaptations required for satellite communications, including aspects related to propagation delay, Doppler effects, and timing synchronization.
• Design and execute testing and validation procedures, including unit testing, system integration testing, and performance benchmarking.
• Contribute to software integration and deployment workflows, including continuous integration and version control practices.
• Stay up to date with 3GPP standardization developments (e.g., NTN features in Releases 17/18/19) and contribute to translating standards into practical implementations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including RF, FPGA, satellite systems, and platform engineering to integrate telecom stacks with hardware and system components.
• Support system-level analysis and debugging, including log analysis, KPI evaluation, and protocol trace inspection.

Basic qualifications

• An academic degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in telecom R&D, preferably working with 3GPP-based wireless systems.
• Solid understanding of 3GPP protocol architecture and procedures in NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR.
• Strong programming skills in C/C++, with additional scripting experience in Python for automation and analysis.
• Experience working in Linux/Unix environments with standard development and debugging tools.
• Familiarity with software development workflows, including version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices. • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex system-level issues.
• Good communication and collaboration skills in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.
• Proficiency in spoken and written English.
• IMPORTANT: Candidate must already reside in Europe or hold a valid European residence permit.

Preferred skills and experience

• Hands-on experience with 3GPP wireless systems, particularly NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR implementations.
• Experience working with NTN architectures and protocol adaptations defined in 3GPP specifications.
• Practical experience analyzing and modifying protocol stack components across L1/L2/L3 layers (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS).
• Familiarity with core network signalling protocols, such as S1AP, NGAP, and GTP-C/U.
• Experience working with software-defined radio platforms (e.g., USRP) or open telecom stacks such as srsRAN and OpenAirInterface, or Open5GS and free5GC.
• Knowledge of O-RAN architecture and functional split concepts.
• Familiarity with Small Cell Forum (SCF) interfaces, including FAPI/nFAPI.
• Background in embedded or real-time software development, particularly on ARM-based or heterogeneous platforms.
• Experience with protocol debugging, KPI analysis, and system performance optimization in wireless communication systems.

Additional Information:  As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.

What we offer:

• Enjoy a 50% income tax exemption on your salary – an exceptional incentive for top talent relocating to Luxembourg, subject to eligibility conditions.
• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week.
• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.
• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.
• Regular company events and team activities.

title: OPERATEUR AMIANTE F/H
description:
Fort des compétences de sa filiale de démolition XARDEL, acquise en 2011, le Groupe COSTANTINI est en mesure de réaliser tous types de travaux de démolition et de déconstruction sélective, jusqu'au tri et la revalorisation des matériaux.


Avec un parc matériel spécifique de plus de 30 machines et une équipe d'opérateurs confirmés, nous sommes capables de proposer des solutions techniques à des démolitions d'immeubles de plus de 30 mètres de hauteur, des ouvrages d'art de tous types, des usines, des maisons individuelles ou même des démolitions intérieures pour réhabilitation.


Nous sommes également en mesure de réaliser des travaux de désamiantage intérieurs ou extérieurs dans le cadre de nos opérations.


La démolition est un métier technique et parfois complexe. Nous avons le savoir-faire et les moyens techniques pour vous accompagner dans vos travaux futurs.


Pour renforcer son équipe de Niederkorn (LU), XARDEL recherche un Opérateur Amiante F/H


Responsabilités :


L'Opérateur Amiante F/H effectue le retrait des matériaux amiantés en respectant strictement les consignes de la hiérarchie.

Voici vos missions :

    Mettre en place les installations de chantier (balisage, confinement, dépression, SAS) et préparer le terrain, les outils, les matériaux nécessaires à l'exécution des travaux,

    Réaliser les travaux de retrait des matériaux contenant de l'amiante dans le respect du plan de retrait établi,

    Repérer, séparer et enlever les différents matériaux : bois, métaux, bardages, déchets inertes (plastique, revêtement) sous la directive du chef de chantier,

    Effectuer les opérations de décontamination (personnelle, matériels, zones) en respectant les consignes de sécurité,

    Assurer le conditionnement, l'étiquetage et l'évacuation des déchets amiantés,

    Renseigner les documents de suivi de chantier (traçabilité, rapports) et rendre compte à la hiérarchie de l'avancement des travaux,

    Utiliser et entretenir les appareils de protection respiratoire et les équipements de protection individuelle (EPI) et collective (EPC).


Compétences requises :

    Connaissance des risques liés à l'amiante (toxicité, pathologies associées, réglementation),

    Lecture et compréhension des modes opératoires (plan de retrait, notice de poste, procédures SS4),

    Savoir reconnaître les matériaux susceptibles de contenir de l'amiante,

    Respect strict des consignes de sécurité (EPI, confinements, décontamination),

    Capacité à utiliser le matériel spécifique (aspirateurs à filtration absolue, unités de décontamination, équipements de confinement),

    Communication et remontée d'informations (alerte en cas de situation à risque),

    Habile de ses mains, disponible et doté·e d'une bonne résistance physique.


Compétences utiles :

    La possession d'ACS/CACES engins de chantier et/ou d'une formation amiante SS3 ou SS4 est considérée comme un atout,

    Connaissance des normes de sécurité.


Nous offrons :

    Un poste à pourvoir immédiatement dans une entreprise dynamique et en pleine croissance,

    Rémunération selon profil et expérience,

    Mutuelle Santé obligatoire et prise en charge à 100%,

    Parcours de formation

title: Senior Unified Communications Engineer — Cisco & Microsoft Teams (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées — Cisco & Microsoft Teams (H/F) — CDI à temps complet

Vous souhaitez rejoindre une société dynamique, leader sur son marché et disposant d'un large portefeuille de solutions ? XXXX Group est à la recherche d'un Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées pour concevoir, déployer et supporter des environnements de téléphonie Cisco et Microsoft Teams avancés pour ses clients.

Mission

Vous intégrerez l'équipe UC Cisco & Applications de XXXX S.A. en tant qu'ingénieur senior, et prendrez en charge les solutions de Communications Unifiées Cisco et Microsoft Teams sur l'ensemble de leur cycle de vie — de l'architecture et la conception jusqu'à l'implémentation et le dépannage avancé.
Vous serez le référent technique et le point d'escalade pour les projets et incidents complexes, en intervenant à la fois sur nos propres plateformes et sur site chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région, dans un environnement professionnel exigeant nécessitant rigueur, autonomie, sens du service et bonne gestion des priorités.

Rôle principal

Dans le cadre de vos activités, vous serez notamment amené à:  

• Concevoir des solutions de communications unifiées (Cisco UC, SIP, Microsoft Teams) adaptées aux besoins des clients, en produisant des dossiers d'architecture de haut et bas niveau (HLD/LLD).
• Piloter l'implémentation et le déploiement des solutions UC:  clusters CUCM, passerelles voix, SBC/CUBE, trunks SIP, téléphones IP Cisco, Jabber/Webex, messagerie vocale et téléphonie Microsoft Teams.
• Définir et construire les plans de numérotation, le routage d'appels, les plans de numéros et les politiques de classe de service sur plusieurs sites.
• Agir comme point d'escalade de niveau 3:  diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents complexes voix, réseau et UC.
• Prendre en charge la sécurité UC:  certificats et PKI, TLS/SRTP, enregistrement sécurisé (CTL/ITL, clusters en mixed-mode) et prévention de la fraude téléphonique (toll fraud).
• Intégrer la UC à l'écosystème environnant:  AD/LDAP, présence, messagerie vocale, supervision et outils de ticketing.
• Piloter les migrations et montées de version, y compris les scénarios Cisco vers Teams et de téléphonie hybride.
• Assurer un leadership technique et le mentorat des techniciens et ingénieurs juniors, et contribuer aux bonnes pratiques internes.
• Assurer l'interface avec les clients, les fournisseurs et les équipes internes, en garantissant la qualité, une communication claire et le respect des délais projet.
• Produire et maintenir une documentation technique claire (dossiers de conception, configurations, as-built et procédures d'exploitation).

Profil recherché

Titulaire d'un diplôme de l'enseignement supérieur en informatique, réseaux ou télécommunications (niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5), ou justifiant d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente, vous disposez d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans des projets de communications unifiées, dans un rôle combinant conception, implémentation et support.
Vous avez une capacité avérée à concevoir une solution, à l'implémenter et à la dépanner de bout en bout, et vous êtes à l'aise pour travailler en autonomie dans un environnement structuré et orienté client, avec un haut niveau d'exigence. Vous savez gérer les priorités et garder une communication professionnelle et claire en toute circonstance.
Les certifications Cisco (CCNP Collaboration / CCIE Collaboration) sont fortement appréciées ; les certifications Microsoft (Teams / Microsoft 365) sont un plus.

Compétences

• L'expertise Cisco Unified Communications est obligatoire : connaissance approfondie de CUCM, Unity Connection, IM&P, Jabber, Webex, téléphones IP Cisco, passerelles voix et SBC/CUBE.
• Maîtrise approfondie du protocole SIP (signalisation, négociation SDP, dépannage) et des flux média RTP/SRTP.
• Solides connaissances en sécurité UC et gestion des certificats: TLS, SRTP, PKI et gestion des certificats, enregistrement sécurisé (CTL/ITL), clusters en mixed-mode et lutte contre la fraude téléphonique.
• Socle réseau IT solide: TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS voix de bout en bout.
• La téléphonie Microsoft Teams est idéale: Teams Phone, Direct Routing, intégration SBC, politiques de routage voix et scénarios hybrides Cisco/Teams.
• Conception et ingénierie de solutions : design de plan de numérotation, haute disponibilité et redondance, Call Admission Control et dimensionnement.
• Dépannage avancé à l'aide des traces SIP/SDL, de RTMT, du Dialed Number Analyzer et de captures réseau (Wireshark).
• Compétences en gestion de projet et en documentation : capacité à piloter des projets techniques et à produire une documentation claire et structurée.

Langues

• Maîtrise du français requise, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
• Bon niveau d'anglais requis (documentation et échanges techniques).
• La maîtrise du luxembourgeois est un atout.

Environnement de travail

Le poste est basé au Luxembourg et combine des activités de projet et de conception avec des interventions sur site chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où la qualité de service, la réactivité, la précision et la communication sont essentielles.
Ce poste conviendra à un professionnel expérimenté souhaitant prendre en charge des projets complexes de communications unifiées, approfondir son expertise sur les solutions

Cisco et Microsoft, et devenir un référent technique au sein d'un intégrateur ICT de premier plan.

Ce que nous proposons

• Un CDI à temps complet.
• Un package attractif.
• Un cycle continu de formation et la possibilité d'évoluer dans l'entreprise.
• Une équipe dynamique et soudée créant un cadre de travail très agréable.
• Une société où l'employé et le client sont au cœur de toutes les attentions.
• Un groupe leader dont le siège au Luxembourg facilite l'adéquation entre organisation, solutions et attente du marché.

Contraintes éventuelles liées au poste:  Extrait de casier judiciaire exigé

À propos de XXXX Group

Fondé en 1929 au Luxembourg, XXXX Group compte actuellement plus de 150 collaborateurs dans de multiples domaines d'activités et actifs dans les secteurs de la finance (agrément PSF), la santé, l'hôtellerie, l'industrie, les services, le secteur public et les Institutions européennes.
XXXX Group (XXXX, XXXX Security, XXXX Telecom et XXXX Soft) fournit des solutions d'intégration ICT, de services Cloud, de sécurité des bâtiments, d'intégration audiovisuelle et d'opérateur téléphonique au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région ainsi qu'une large palette de solutions IT et un service d'éditeur d'applications métiers.
Nous accompagnons les administrations, les grandes entreprises et les PME avec la même vision claire : se poser en partenaire fiable, flexible et innovant.

Comment postuler
Vous possédez les qualités requises ci-dessus? Veuillez s'il vous plaît envoyer votre lettre de motivation et votre curriculum vitae (en français ou en anglais) à l'adresse jobs@XXXX.com en indiquant « Candidature au poste d'Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées (H/F) ».
Votre candidature sera traitée en toute confidentialité.

title: Senior Software Engineer I – Subsidy Projects (Fixed-Term 24 months) (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Senior Software Engineer I – Subsidy Projects (Fixed-Term 24 months)

Luxembourg - Esch-sur-Alzette
Full-time
Fixed-term
71,500 - 79,500 € per year

Who we are

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.

Purpose of the job / project

Play a key role in the improvement and innovation of IT solutions within a dynamic agile team delivering high-quality services across key data domains. Contribute to major European and national initiatives, including HDAB2-LU, supporting the establishment of the Luxembourg Health Data Access Body and enabling secure, compliant, and efficient access to health data.
Support the delivery of strategic national and European initiatives focused on secure data sharing, health and research data ecosystems, and trustworthy AI adoption. Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable, compliant, and impactful digital solutions in a complex multi-stakeholder environment.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will independently design, implement, deliver and maintain applications and platform services, integrating new solutions with LNDS's existing data-centric infrastructures. You will take ownership of defined technical areas, translating requirements into reliable, secure and maintainable solutions within agreed architectural and organisational standards. You will actively identify and deliver opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation, focusing on:

• Automating the software development lifecycle.
• Improving internal data flows, tooling and platform capabilities.
• Developing and supporting technical environments for data processing, analytics and AI-related experimentation.

You will be part of the Technology team, working closely with data specialists, AI experts and governance teams across different projects. You will contribute to high-impact European initiatives in AI, data governance and digital public infrastructure, exercising sound judgment about when to act independently, seek specialist input or escalate risks.

What you will do

• Develop, deliver and maintain quality software
• Contribute to application design and integration with existing data-centric infrastructures
• Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation, automating parts of the software development process, internal data flows, and internal tooling
• Collaborate within the agile software development team, delivering and maintaining quality software as required by the Platform

• Design and provide excellent issue tracking and customer support with the team
• Write and maintain comprehensive documentation
• Offer technical expertise to external parties and represent LNDS in meetings, conferences, and gatherings with stakeholders
• Support more junior colleagues
• Stay up to date with evolving software technologies

Who you are

• MSc in a scientific, technological, or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology, or computing
• 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in programming, deployment, and maintenance of applications
• Experience taking a feature, service or application from requirements through implementation, deployment and ongoing support
• Experience in data-related or research-oriented environments is considered an asset

Technical competencies

• Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with the ability to independently develop, test and maintain production software. Other languages are considered a plus
• Solid knowledge of backend development, including API design, services, integrations and error handling
• Frontend experience with React and Next.js is considered an asset
• Practical experience building, running and troubleshooting containerised applications using Docker or Podman
• Working knowledge of authentication and identity technologies, with experience integrating applications using relevant protocols or solutions such as OIDC, SAML, LDAP/AD or Keycloak
• Solid knowledge of SQL databases, including data modelling and query development; working knowledge of NoSQL technologies
• Working knowledge of cloud environments and application deployment, configuration and monitoring
• Practical experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines
• Confidence working independently in Linux and Git-based development environments
• Ability to assess technical trade-offs involving maintainability, reliability, performance, security and delivery effort

Professional competencies

• Demonstrated ownership and accountability for the quality, delivery and ongoing operation of assigned solutions
• Ability to work independently with limited day-to-day supervision, while recognising when alignment, specialist input or escalation is needed
• Analytical, solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to break down moderately complex problems and resolve incomplete or ambiguous requirements
• Practical commitment to security and privacy by design
• Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholder
• Ability to collaborate effectively in interdisciplinary and multicultural environments
• Proactive approach to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and constructive feedback
• Ability to manage priorities and adapt to evolving requirements in projects with long-term impact
• Commitment to continued learning and the practical application of relevant technologies
• Cultural intelligence and diversity consciousness
• Fluent in English

About us

What we offer

• Dynamic and innovative work environment
• Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
• Inclusive and diverse culture
• European recognition and impactful projects
• Shape the future of the data revolution

What sets us apart
The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking. We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission. We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies. Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character. Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values. We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.  
Join LNDS and revolutionise the data economy!
Be part of our dynamic team driving innovation and making a tangible impact. Collaborate on cutting-edge projects, gaining European recognition in the prestigious European Data [...]

title: Responsable des Ressources Humaines (m/f)
description:
Description:


RESPONSABLE DES RESSOURCES HUMAINES (M/F/X)
Luxembourg | CDI | Management RH & Excellence opérationnelle


✓ Vous disposez d'une solide expérience dans le pilotage opérationnel d'un service RH, avec une maîtrise des enjeux sociaux, juridiques et organisationnels propres au Luxembourg ?
✓ Vous êtes un(e) manager RH de terrain, capable de piloter une équipe, de structurer les processus et de garantir la qualité des opérations RH au quotidien ?
✓ Vous savez évoluer dans des environnements humains et organisationnels complexes, avec diplomatie, courage managérial et sens des responsabilités ?

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans ces trois dimensions, cette opportunité pourrait vous intéresser.


NOTRE CLIENT:

Notre client est une organisation luxembourgeoise évoluant dans le secteur de la santé, au sein d'un environnement professionnel exigeant, réunissant des expertises et des métiers diversifiés.
Dans le cadre du renforcement de son organisation RH, nous recherchons un(e) Responsable des Ressources Humaines pour assurer le pilotage opérationnel du service, accompagner les équipes et contribuer à l'amélioration continue des pratiques RH.
Cette fonction s'adresse à un(e) professionnel(le) expérimenté(e), qui apprécie les responsabilités managériales, la proximité avec le terrain et la résolution de problématiques RH concrètes.
Un poste où la maîtrise des fondamentaux RH, la qualité du management et la capacité à instaurer des relations de confiance seront déterminantes.


VOTRE RÔLE:

Rattaché(e) à la Direction Administrative et Financière, vous prenez la responsabilité d'une équipe RH pluridisciplinaire intervenant sur l'ensemble des activités de gestion des ressources humaines.
Votre priorité : garantir un service RH fiable, structuré, réactif et pleinement orienté vers les besoins de l'organisation et de ses collaborateurs.
Vous assurez le management quotidien de votre équipe, la supervision des processus RH et l'accompagnement des managers sur leurs problématiques humaines et organisationnelles.
Vous bénéficiez d'une autonomie dans la gestion opérationnelle de votre service et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec votre direction sur les projets et décisions structurantes.
Il s'agit avant tout d'une fonction de responsable de service à forte dimension opérationnelle, associant management de proximité, expertise technique et contribution à l'évolution des pratiques RH.


VOS RESPONSABILITÉS:


Management et pilotage opérationnel du service RH

Encadrer, accompagner et développer les compétences de votre équipe RH.
Organiser les activités du service, définir les priorités et assurer une répartition efficace des responsabilités.
Garantir la qualité, la fiabilité et la continuité des prestations RH.
Accompagner les collaborateurs dans leur autonomie et leur professionnalisation.
Mettre en place des indicateurs de suivi et améliorer les processus internes.
Favoriser un fonctionnement collectif fondé sur la responsabilisation, la collaboration et la confiance.

Supervision de la paie et de l'administration du personnel

Superviser l'ensemble du processus de paie et garantir sa fiabilité.
Veiller à la conformité des pratiques avec le droit du travail luxembourgeois, les obligations sociales et les dispositions conventionnelles applicables.
Sécuriser les processus d'administration du personnel, de gestion contractuelle et de suivi des dossiers individuels.
Identifier les risques opérationnels et mettre en place les contrôles et procédures nécessaires.
Contribuer à l'optimisation et à la digitalisation des processus RH.
Une connaissance approfondie des mécanismes de paie et de l'administration RH au Luxembourg est indispensable pour exercer pleinement cette fonction.

Accompagnement RH des managers et relations sociales
