About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
The Department of Engineering (DoE) is a dynamic, interdisciplinary group engaged in civil, electrical, mechanical engineering and operations research/management, driving forward innovative research and solutions. It also has an internationally leading profile in computational science and engineering. We develop cutting-edge technologies, promoting the sustainable and economical use of resources, and meeting the technological demands of Luxembourg, the Greater Region, and beyond. Nearly all research projects are supported by a network of national and international partnerships, several with public or industrial stakeholders. At the University, the Department cooperates across faculties and with the interdisciplinary centres. In particular, the new interdisciplinary centre focused on complex environmental systems opens up significant opportunities for future collaborations.
The Department of Engineering seeks to hire a Research Support Engineer, with an interdisciplinary background in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, to integrate the Technical Support Unit (TSU). The candidate will work closely with the Technical Support Unit (TSU) Team Leader across all DoE research areas.

Your role
As a Research Support Engineer within the Department of Engineering TSU, you'll have an exciting and diverse job, typically at the intersection of technical support and project management. You'll be involved in research activities but as well support the Department outreach and education missions.
Support management tasks:
• Project management: Plan and coordinate research support activities, allocate resources, set timelines, continuously evaluate and optimise resource utilisation to improve efficiency and ensure project deliverables are met, in close collaboration with the Principal Investigator
• Acquisition/procurement: Organise together with the PI the purchase of materials, equipment and software. Keep the maintenance and update of licenses schedules
• Laboratory Management: Ensure all laboratory equipment is properly maintained, calibrated, and functioning optimally. Implement and enforce safety protocols to maintain a safe working environment, in collaboration with the FSTM Safety Officers. Oversee that researchers create and maintain accurate lab books
• Communication: Support the Team Leader in the liaison between PIs and relevant central administration services, e.g. procurement, infrastructures, safety and security, in collaboration with the Head of Department and the Deanship

Technical Support and Development:
• Work closely with researchers to understand their technical needs, provide advice on technical solutions and facilitate the translation of research questions into technical implementations
• Setup of experimental platforms involving sensors, instrumentation, and physical measurements, support to prototyping, including the involvement in the design, wiring, commissioning, and troubleshooting of systems
• Coordination and supervision of experimental work together with the PIs
• Liaising with companies and experts to guarantee the efficient, timely, and quality supply of services, software, equipment and laboratory consumables
• Good practices in documenting prototypes, procedures, and experimental results
• Ability to read and write technical documents: schematics, protocols, reports

Your profile
• Master's degree in mechanical, electrical engineering, or similar
• Leadership skills, experience as a team coordinator
• At least 7 years of experience in academia, in charge of supervision of experimental tasks: in the fields of mechanical and civil engineering - structures, knowledge in thermodynamics would be considered an asset
• Interest in academic environments and collaborative research is highly valued
• Adaptability and eagerness to learn
• Problem-solving attitude
• Excellent command of English (C1) is required for international communication and documentation. Excellent command of French or German (C1) is mandatory

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Curriculum Vitae, including any publications or technical projects, if applicable
• Cover letter
Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

title: Gérant(e)-Gestionnaire du Camping Bon Accueil à Alzingen (m/f)
employer: Syndicat d'Initiative et de Tourisme de la commune de Hesperange A.S.B.L.
description:
Description des tâches:

Le Syndicat d'Initiative et de Tourisme de la Commune de Hesperange, ASBL recrute:

Gérant(e)-Gestionnaire du Camping Bon Accueil à Alzingen

Dans le cadre de la gestion et du développement du Camping Bon Accueil à Alzingen, le Syndicat d'Initiative et de Tourisme de la Commune de Hesperange, ASBL recherche, pour entrée immédiate, un(e) Gérant(e)-Gestionnaire à temps plein.
En tant que responsable du Camping, vous assurez la gestion opérationnelle, administrative et organisationnelle de l'établissement. Vous bénéficiez d'une autonomie dans l'exercice de vos fonctions et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le Conseil du Syndicat, auquel vous rapportez directement.
Vous aurez également la responsabilité de coordonner et d'encadrer une équipe multidisciplinaire active dans les domaines de l'accueil, du tourisme, de la restauration et de l'entretien.

Vos missions

Gestion et organisation du Camping

• Assurer la gestion opérationnelle et l'organisation quotidienne du Camping;
• Planifier, coordonner et superviser le travail des différents collaborateurs;
• Établir les plannings et assurer une répartition efficace des tâches et des responsabilités;
• Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et des services proposés aux clients;
• Assurer la gestion des réservations, de l'accueil téléphonique et physique ainsi que de la boîte e-mail;
• Assurer la facturation, le suivi administratif, la gestion des fournisseurs, l'établissement des statistiques et des rapports d'activité;
• Veiller au respect des procédures internes et proposer, lorsque nécessaire, des améliorations.

Management et gestion d'équipe

• Encadrer, motiver et coordonner une équipe multidisciplinaire;
• Assurer une bonne communication au sein de l'équipe et favoriser un environnement de travail collaboratif;
• Organiser et superviser les activités des collaborateurs en fonction des besoins opérationnels;
• Participer au recrutement, à l'intégration et à l'accompagnement des collaborateurs, en collaboration avec le Conseil du Syndicat;
• Veiller au respect des règles de sécurité, d'hygiène et d'organisation du travail.

Infrastructures et qualité

• Assurer le contrôle régulier de l'état et du bon fonctionnement des infrastructures et équipements du Camping;
• Coordonner les travaux d'entretien et de maintenance et assurer le suivi avec les prestataires externes;
• Identifier les besoins d'amélioration et proposer des solutions au Conseil du Syndicat;
• Participer à la planification et assurer le suivi des projets de renouvellement, de modernisation et de développement du Camping.

Tourisme, communication et développement

• Contribuer activement à la promotion du Camping Bon Accueil et des activités touristiques de la Commune de Hesperange;
• Participer à la valorisation de l'image et de l'attractivité du Camping;
• Entretenir des relations professionnelles avec les clients, partenaires, fournisseurs et acteurs locaux du secteur touristique.

Votre profil

Vous êtes une personne autonome, dynamique et orientée vers le service, capable de prendre des responsabilités et de gérer des situations variées dans un environnement touristique et opérationnel.

Vous disposez idéalement de:

• Une expérience professionnelle confirmée dans un poste de gestion, de coordination ou de responsabilité, dans le secteur touristique, hôtelier, de la restauration ou dans tout autre environnement impliquant un contact régulier avec la clientèle;
• Une première expérience réussie dans la gestion et l'encadrement d'une équipe;
• Une bonne capacité d'organisation et de planification;
• Un excellent sens du service et de la relation client;
• Une bonne capacité à prendre des décisions, à gérer les priorités et à résoudre les problèmes de manière autonome;
• Un esprit d'initiative et une volonté constante d'améliorer les processus et la qualité des services;
• Une bonne maîtrise du français, de l'allemand et de l'anglais. La connaissance du luxembourgeois constitue un avantage;
• Une bonne maîtrise des outils MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook);
• La connaissance du logiciel Tommy Booking constitue un avantage;
• Une personnalité enthousiaste, sociable, conviviale et orientée vers les solutions;
• De la polyvalence, de la flexibilité et de la rigueur dans l'exécution des différentes tâches en lien avec votre fonction;
• Une bonne résistance au stress et la capacité à rester efficace dans des périodes de forte activité.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un poste à responsabilités avec une réelle autonomie dans la gestion opérationnelle du Camping;
• Une fonction variée et évolutive au sein d'un environnement touristique dynamique;
• La possibilité de diriger et de développer une équipe multidisciplinaire;
• Une collaboration directe avec le Conseil du Syndicat d'Initiative et de Tourisme de la Commune de Hesperange;
• La possibilité de contribuer activement au développement et à la modernisation du Camping Bon Accueil;
• Une rémunération attractive, en adéquation avec votre expérience, vos compétences et vos responsabilités;

Conditions de travail

• Contrat à durée indéterminée;
• Temps plein;
• Travail selon un planning établi en fonction des besoins du Camping, avec disponibilité du lundi au dimanche, y compris pendant les vacances scolaires et les périodes de forte activité;
• Prise de fonction: immédiate ou à convenir.

Comment postuler?

Les personnes intéressées sont invitées à envoyer leur dossier de candidature comprenant:

• un curriculum vitae détaillé avec photo récente;
• une lettre de motivation;
• une copie de la carte d'identité;
• un extrait du casier judiciaire.

Les candidatures sont à envoyer jusqu'au 02/11/2026:
Par courriel: gestion@camping-alzingen.lu
ou
Par voie postale:
Syndicat d'Initiative et de Tourisme de la Commune de Hesperange, ASBL
2, rue du Camping
L-5815 Alzingen

Les candidatures seront traitées avec confidentialité. Les candidat(e)s retenu(e)s seront contacté(e)s par les responsables du Syndicat d'Initiative et de Tourisme de la Commune de Hesperange, ASBL.
Pour toute question concernant le poste, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter par courriel.

Études:  Bachelor (Bac +3)

Métier / domaine de formation:  Gestion d'entreprise; Ressources humaines;

Autres compétences:  utilisation des outils informatiques conventionnels; fonctionnement d'un camping; gestion d'infrastructures

title: Risk Analytics Lead (m/f/d)
description:
Risk Analytics Lead (m/f/d)
Job ID: REF3057H
Company: Riverty GmbH
Location: Luxembourg
Daria Manoilenko
Recruiting

I look forward to receiving your application

Everyone's story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don't have to worry about it.

And there's more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

We are looking for a

Risk Analytics Lead (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Luxembourg - flexible working conditions available

We are looking for a Lead for a Risk Analytics team with a strong analytical and hands-on attitude that is keen to have an impact on our risk analytics and related processes by data-oriented insights in terms of external end customer's solvency / fraud indicators in a balanced risk decision environment. The focus of the team lies on helping our steering teams defining our risk strategy, its (further) development and the constant monitoring and steering according to it. In line with the company's overarching vision to become the most human-centric FinTech, the Risk Analytics team develops appropriate customer risk strategies for different markets and ecosystems. The organization is characterized by technology-based rapid learning and decision-making cycles and guided by a strong common purpose to jointly create value for all stakeholders. Strong footprint in DACH/NL & Nordics with further expansion ambition within Europe (example: France, Italy, Spain & UK).

The main responsibilities of the Risk Analytics Lead are:

• Leading a high-performing team of risk analytics experts in an international setup
• Ensuring that the team uses industry-standard analytics tools and data-driven decision-making to solve complex fraud / solvency risk related problems and support product expansion
• Driving continuous improvement of underlying data analyses, existing business processes and monitoring/reporting, while establishing best practices for ad-hoc and deep-dive analyses
• Providing risk insights for pricing requests and ensuring effective collaboration with internal stakeholders on analytical requirements
• Playing a key role in cross-functional Risk Data Science initiatives and in enabling machine learning based models and advanced analytics for risk decisioning
• Representing the Risk Analytics team in key projects with project responsibility for risk steering related analytics and implementation
You will lead the Risk Analytics team and work in close collaboration with other functions such as Risk Product, Risk Steering, Data Science, Pricing, Financial Controlling, Sales and Operations.
The function is reporting into the Risk Analytics & Steering Lead, which is reporting into the global Client Underwriting Lead. The location is flexible, preferred locations are Luxembourg, Germany (Berlin, Verl, Baden-Baden) and the Netherlands (Amsterdam, Heerenveen).

What you should bring:

• You have a proven track-record in data analytics and credit risk management, ideally within a Bank / BNPL industry / fast-growing payment industry.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in leading (cross-border) teams in a relevant area such as credit risk analytics, ideally in an international, agile, cross-functional environment
• You have experience in successfully enabling machine learning-based models and advanced analytics for risk assessment and decisioning
• Expertise in using various programming languages (SQL and Python) to perform complex analytical tasks
• You embrace new technology and understand the potential of data and advanced analytics
• You are a strategic thinker with vision and a strong operator - you get things done
• Language: English (mandatory); German or Dutch is a plus

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

We want to be a fair and inclusive employer. We value the diverse perspectives that a diverse workforce brings to the table. Therefore, we are actively looking for people who enrich our company through their identity, background and personal experiences, with or without a disability.

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.
The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.
You can contact the company's Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.
Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here: https://jobsearch.createyourowncareer.com/content/Privacy-Policy/?locale=en_US

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
Join our Luxembourg team where your expertise directly contributes to humanity's greatest adventure, while maintaining the work-life harmony that makes great engineering possible. Be part of a collaborative, inclusive culture where safety and technical excellence drive every decision as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight from the heart of Europe.
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We're working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!
As part of a hardworking team of supply chain professionals, technicians, and engineers, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our organization adheres to all relevant regulations, develops automated compliance reports, and educates our teams on designing compliant processes. The International Supply Chain Manager manages relationships with non-US external vendors and suppliers, ensuring contractual obligations are fulfilled while protecting the organization's interests, maintaining compliance, and optimizing.

Special Mentions:

Relocation provided
Travel expected up to 25% of the time
Interviews may will include a technical assessment

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Global Supplier Development & Relationship Management

Identify, evaluate, and onboard suppliers across international markets based on quality, capacity, reliability, and cost
Build and nurture cross-cultural business relationships that respect regional practices and communication styles
Monitor supplier performance against KPIs and implement improvement strategies across global operations

International Contract & Financial Management

Negotiate and administer agreements compliant with multiple legal jurisdictions and international standards
Leverage global market intelligence to secure optimal pricing while balancing quality and risk
Manage currency fluctuations, payment terms, and financial controls across international transactions
Maintain comprehensive documentation of all contract activities and changes

Global Compliance & Risk Mitigation

Ensure adherence to international trade regulations, export/import laws, and country-specific requirements
Identify and address risks unique to global procurement (political instability, logistics disruptions, trade disputes)
Implement appropriate risk management strategies through contract terms, insurance requirements, and contingency planning
Coordinate quality assurance across international suppliers to maintain consistent standards

Global Supply Chain Optimization

Manage international logistics, customs clearance, and documentation requirements
Implement efficiency improvements in global procurement processes and inventory management
Generate performance analytics on international supplier metrics and compliance reporting
Stay informed about international market trends and regional business conditions that impact supply chain decisions

Strategic Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with legal, finance, engineering, and logistics teams across global operations
Align international procurement activities with organizational objectives and program requirements
Facilitate effective communication between international suppliers and internal stakeholders
Serve as subject matter expert on global sourcing strategies and international supply markets

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, international business, or related field
Experience: 5+ years in international procurement or supplier management
Language Skills: Proficiency in multiple languages relevant to key supplier regions
Knowledge: Understanding of international trade laws, customs regulations, and global logistics
Travel Capability: Willingness to travel internationally (typically 20-30%)
Cultural Competence: Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures and business environments
Technical Skills: Proficiency with global procurement systems and international payment platforms
Domain Expertise: Engineering, Manufacturing or Procurement experience across multiple aerospace domains and commodities

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelors degree and/or previous working experience as an Engineer, Apprentice or Technician
Experience working in a multi-cultural environment with both internal and external customers and stakeholders
Experience with ISO 9001, AS9100, or other quality management systems in aerospace
Fluent in multiple languages

Culture Statement

Don't meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right
candidate for this or other roles.

Criminal Record Check

Given the nature of the work we do at Blue Origin, which allows access to sensitive and proprietary information of our company and customers, please be aware that, in accordance with the amended law of 29 March 2013 on the organisation of criminal records, the selected candidate will be requested to provide an extract from the criminal record (bulletin n°3)

We're committed to building the road to space so our children can build the future. We are a mission-driven company focused on ideas and innovation, and encourage fresh perspectives from bold voices. title: Partner & Client Services Officer – Italy, Portugal and Spain (m/f)
description:
Partner & Client Services Officer – Italy, Portugal and Spain

Location  Leudelange
Experience Level  Experienced
Home Office  Yes, partially possible

Your Job in a Nutshell

As a Partner & Client Services Officer – Italy, Portugal and Spain, you will manage the administrative and relationship aspects of life insurance contracts for the Italian, Portuguese and Spain markets throughout their entire lifecycle.
As a key point of contact for our clients and partners, you will ensure a high level of service, coordinate operations with internal stakeholders and actively contribute to the continuous improvement of our processes and tools within an international and multicultural environment.

What you can expect

• Managing the full administration of life insurance contracts, from onboarding through to contract termination.
• Handling day-to-day and complex transactions, including subscriptions, redemptions, switches, contractual changes, and transactions involving internal and external funds.
• Acting as a key point of contact for clients and partners, including brokers, banks and asset managers, and building strong and lasting professional relationships.
• Responding to requests relating to contracts and ongoing transactions and proactively proposing solutions tailored to identified needs.
• Working closely with internal teams such as AML, KYC, Assets Controlling, Wealth Planning, Accounting and Sales to ensure quality and timely execution of operations.
• Prepare, coordinate and submit Italian tax and regulatory reporting to the relevant authorities, ensuring data accuracy, timely filings and proper reconciliations; liaise with external tax advisors experts to ensure compliance with Italian tax and insurance regulations.Actively contributing to the continuous improvement of processes and digital tools.
• Participating in strategic projects related to quality, data and operational optimisation.

What we expect

• Education: Minimum Bachelor's degree (Bac+3) in Economics, Business Administration, Finance or equivalent.
• Experience: Previous experience in a similar role within banking or insurance is preferred. For the Supervisor role, at least 5 years of experience in an operations or similar position is expected.
• Languages: Excellent command of Portuguese, with strong working proficiency in French, English and Italian. Any additional language would be considered an asset.
• Technical skills: Good knowledge of life insurance products, ideally LPS, experience in handling complex administrative transactions and good command of Microsoft Office.
• Soft skills: Strong client and service orientation, proactivity, autonomy, organisational skills, accuracy and team spirit.

About Baloise

We are more than a traditional insurance company: we are the personal partner for everyone who wants to feel simply safe. In addition to our traditional financial business, we are also broadening our range with ecosystems in the areas of mobility and home. We see the digital age as an opportunity to make our offering even more sustainable, innovative and customer-oriented in the future. Are you shaping it with us?

We give you the freedom to pursue your ideas. Get involved! Question us! Develop yourself and us even further! Our culture of learning and making mistakes as well as communication at eye level all make this possible. Because only together can we move forward.

title: Research Data Specialist (m/f)
description:
Description:


Your role

As a Research Data Specialist, you will support researchers in managing data across the research lifecycle. You will implement FAIR-compliant RDM strategies and collaborate with data and library specialists across faculties, working at the intersection of research and infrastructure in a diverse, forward-looking environment.


Key responsibilities:

• Contribute to the design and implementation of guidelines and procedures for adequate data lifecycle management, standards, documentation, and information security
• Assist with managing data submissions, e.g. sequencing, clinical assay and survey data, handling data access requests and support in downstream processes, while ensuring appropriate documentation and metadata standards
• Facilitate data preservation, archiving and sharing
• Contribute to specific project deliverables as required
• Contribute to the development of innovative discipline-specific services and tools relevant to research data
• Contribute to the development of training materials on relevant topics, including Data Management and Reproducibility
• Contribute to projects, project deliverables, scientific publications, and community work in the field of Data Stewardship
• Contribute to the development and improvement of procedures/practices, as well as novel IT solutions as required by advancements in the field
• Collaborate with IT, Library and Research Support teams to promote coordinated data management services


Your profile:

• Postgraduate/Master's degree/qualification in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related discipline
• Demonstrable experience of collaborative research, research data management and data quality control
• Demonstrable computer programming skills are essential, with good knowledge of CLI and Python/R
• Proven experience using REDCap for the design, management, and export of study data
• Good knowledge of research practice, as well as a broad understanding of how research operates, and how data and software underpin reproducible research
• Knowledge of metadata standards and ontologies relevant to the fields of  life sciences, medicine and health is considered an asset
• Experience with biomedical and health data is considered an asset, including data derived from electronic health records, patient-generated data, clinical, omics, imaging data
• Knowledge and experience of an ELN software is considered an asset
• Fluency in English is required


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

title: HR Business Partner (m/f)
employer: Sometimes, Sàrl - Crèches Rockids S.A R.L.
description:
HR Business Partner (M/W)

Rockids, a network of nurseries operated by the La Maison Bleue Group, supports children and their families every day through a caring, innovative educational approach focused on children's development. Rockids is a recognized leader in the early childhood sector and operates 24 small-scale centers across Luxembourg, where quality of care, educational excellence, and staff well-being are at the heart of every project.
Joining Rockids means becoming part of a leading international group in the early childhood sector while working within a local, close-knit organization.

As an HR Business Partner, you will help shape the company's HR practices, support managers in their day-to-day challenges, and foster a high-performing work environment that promotes employee development.

Your primary mission will be to support the company's growth by implementing and continuously improving the HR processes that underpin its development.

As a true partner to senior management and teams, you will work across a broad range of responsibilities, including recruitment, HR development, HR administration, project management, and employee relations.

Your Role and Responsibilities

Recruitment and Onboarding

You will be responsible for the full recruitment process, from identifying staffing needs to onboarding new employees.
In this role, you will:

• Analyze hiring needs with facility directors and managers, taking into account staffing levels, operational requirements, and regulatory staff-to-resident ratios.
• Define candidate profiles and draft job descriptions and job postings.
• Post job openings and develop new recruitment channels.
• Proactively propose initiatives to strengthen the Group's attractiveness and employer brand.
• Conduct telephone pre-screenings for key roles across our facilities, including educational assistants, care assistants, educators, and facility managers.
• Conduct interviews and support managers throughout the recruitment process.
• Take a direct role in critical or sensitive hires and support less experienced managers in conducting interviews.
• Support newly appointed department heads as they develop their recruitment skills.
• Manage the administrative follow-up of applications.
• Coordinate the onboarding of new employees and monitor their probationary periods.

Supporting Managers and Teams

As a partner to managers and teams, you will support them in addressing their day-to-day HR challenges.

In particular, you will:

• Provide HR oversight and support to teams.
• Monitor and address absenteeism and turnover.
• Advise managers on disciplinary matters.
• Support skills development and employee development initiatives.
• Support the implementation of HR policies and procedures.
• Provide managers with practical HR advice tailored to operational realities and the specific needs of each location.

HR Administration

Working closely with our third-party service providers and internal teams, you will ensure the reliability and smooth execution of HR administrative processes.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

• Managing payroll processes, including preparing and submitting payroll data and generating monthly reports.
• Preparing employment contracts and contract amendments.
• Managing and maintaining the HRIS.
• Monitoring administrative procedures related to medical examinations and other regulatory requirements.
• Coordinating end-of-contract procedures.
• Maintaining relationships with our payroll service provider, government authorities, and other HR service providers.

HR Management and Reporting

You will contribute to the effective management of the HR function by producing and analyzing HR data.

Specifically, you will be responsible for:

• Maintaining HR dashboards and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of HR data, including turnover and absenteeism figures.
• Analyzing key HR metrics related to absenteeism, turnover, recruitment, and payroll costs.
• Identifying trends and areas of concern and proposing appropriate corrective actions.
• Preparing HR reports and presentations for senior management.
• Developing new HR metrics and reporting tools based on the Group's needs.

HR Projects

You will play an active role in shaping and developing the Group's HR strategy and policies.

In particular, you will:

• Contribute to defining and implementing the HR strategy.
• Structure and continuously improve HR processes, particularly in the areas of recruitment and onboarding.
• Oversee the onboarding process for new employees.
• Implement and monitor training and skills development programs.
• Participate in interview campaigns and performance review processes.
• Contribute to the development of the employer brand and internal communications.
• Conduct employee engagement and satisfaction surveys, analyze the results, and propose action plans.
• Participate in discussions regarding salary structures and compensation, in collaboration with senior management.
• Support the implementation of new HR tools and processes.
• Proactively suggest initiatives to improve the employee experience.

Compliance and HR Monitoring

You will ensure compliance with the legal and regulatory framework applicable to the company and will:
• Monitor developments in employment law and HR regulations.
• Collaborate with our law firm and external partners on matters requiring specific expertise.
• Support management in handling sensitive individual employee situations.

Your Profile

We are looking for an HR professional with at least 3 years of experience in a generalist HR role or as an HR Business Partner, ideally in a multi-site environment.
You have a solid understanding of HR practices and are comfortable working across the key areas of the HR function.

Qualifications and Skills

You are known for:

• Your independence and strong sense of responsibility.
• Your ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
• Your attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
• Your analytical and problem-solving abilities, as well as your ability to synthesize information.
• Your excellent interpersonal skills and ability to build trusting relationships with managers and colleagues.
• Your pragmatic, solution-oriented approach.
• Your discretion and commitment to confidentiality.
• Your ability to stay connected to operational realities while providing proactive insights and recommendations to senior management.

Technical Skills

• A higher education degree in Human Resources, Management, Employment Law, or a related field.
• At least 3 years of experience in a generalist HR or HR Business Partner role.
• A strong understanding of employment law and operational HR practices.
• Excellent proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, including dashboards, KPI tracking, and reporting.
• Proficiency in digital tools and HR information systems (GesperPersonnel).
• Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken.
• Experience working in a multi-site environment is highly desirable.

Working Conditions

• Position based at Rockids' headquarters in Luxembourg, reporting directly to senior management.
• Flexible working hours, free meals and parking, company car, and performance-based bonus.

Why Join Us?

• Grow alongside a committed, multidisciplinary local leadership team at the heart of the company's governance and transformation.
• Join a leading international group in the early childhood sector with a strong local presence.
• Take on a position of responsibility offering genuine autonomy and a broad range of responsibilities.
• Gain cross-functional experience by working with teams across the La Maison Bleue Group in France, England, and Switzerland.

title: Research Scientist in Economics of Sustainability (m/f)
description:
Description:


Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems
Job Number: UOL08508
Contract Type: Permanent
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Job Level: level 1
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Cluster
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist


Your role:

The successful candidate will establish internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems.
The candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.
A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.


Your profile:

The successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.
Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.
The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.


The ideal candidate will have:

• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 4 years Postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda
• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions
• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding
• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systems


Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English. The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.


We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance


How to apply:

Applications should contain:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable


All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.


General Information:

• Reference: UOL08508 (to be mentioned in all correspondence)
• Publication date: -
• Contract Type: Permanent
• Working Hours:  
• Location: Belval Campus
• Planned starting date: 01/11/2026


Gender equality:

In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, diversity and a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of everybody is respected. The University is committed to achieving gender parity among its academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

Launch MBA Program

Description

Launch - Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe

Opportunities in locations including: the UK, Luxembourg, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Sweden and the Netherlands. Fluency in English is essential for all roles in Europe and local language skills are highly desirable for some positions, but are not essential for every role.

At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.
Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...

• Our businesses by reviewing Press Releases on our Investor Relations site, CEO Andy Jassy's 2022 Letter to Shareholders, and the first letter shared in 1997, which is included in our annual report each year
• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.
• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

Example full-time job functions include:

• Sr. Business Development Manager: Partners with business leaders to grow the business by creating new partnerships, leveraging existing relationships, and/or licensing assets to drive product improvements and innovation, enable distribution of our application, products and/or services, and reduce costs without sacrificing the customer experience.
• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

Basic Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in a full-time MBA program at time of application
• Graduating between December 1, 2025 and September 30, 2026
• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program

Preferred Qualifications

• 4+ years of full-time industry/military work experience prior to your MBA
• Fluency in a European language (e.g., German, French, Italian, Spanish)
• Demonstration of interest in the technology industry, such as: Undergraduate/Master's degree in computer science or engineering; prior work experience in a start-up or technology company; SQL or programming experience, etc.
• Experience in sales or account management
• Demonstrated capability of both high-level strategic thinking and detailed execution
• Consistent track record of taking ownership and driving results
• Comfortable with “hands-on” management of tasks, and proven ability to manage multiple, contending priorities simultaneously

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

Example full-time job functions include:

• Sr. Business Development Manager: Partners with business leaders to grow the business by creating new partnerships, leveraging existing relationships, and/or licensing assets to drive product improvements and innovation, enable distribution of our application, products and/or services, and reduce costs without sacrificing the customer experience.
• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

title: Data and Process Manager for our International Non-Life team (m/f)
description:
Data and Process Manager for our International Non-Life team

Location  Leudelange
Experience Level  Experienced
Home Office  Yes, partially possible

Your Job in a Nutshell

• Within our International Non-Life department, we are building a new Pan-European business branch operating under the Freedom of Service (FoS) regime.
• Our ambition: bring innovative insurance solutions to B2B partners across Europe — from MGAs and brokers to corporate clients seeking fronting solutions for their captives.
• As Data and Process Manager, you will play a key role in structuring and supervising the entire data process exchange for our international operations.
• You will also be in charge of building processes and optimizing them to create the most efficient organization. You will ensure that data provided by third-party are handled efficiently, compliantly, and in line with Baloise's best practices — a cornerstone of our competitiveness.
• You will work within a multidisciplinary international team operating in start-up and agile mode, reporting directly to the Head of International Non-Life.
• You will be part of an international team shaping a new line of business within a stable and reputable insurance group, with the opportunity to make a tangible impact on our European growth story.

What you can expect

Your main missions will be to:

Financial Management and Data Quality:

• Manage operational financial flows and work closely with Finance teams to ensure the timely and accurate transmission of data.
• Ensure the consistency and reliability of technical and financial data, notably by overseeing proper data reconciliation with actuarial teams and collaborating with partners to enhance the integrity of incoming data flows.

Operational and Cross-Functional Support:

• Coordinate operations across internal teams and external partners.
• Support claims management, fraud investigations, and customer complaints handling, while assisting in the design and deployment of operational processes with partners.
• Collaborate with legal and technical stakeholders whenever required.
• Take ownership of cross-functional topics and urgent requests that have not yet been allocated within the team, stepping in where necessary to ensure business continuity and the successful delivery of activities across functions.
Process Management and Cross-Functional Coordination:
• Define, formalize, document, and continuously improve business processes, including underwriting, claims management, data flows, and reporting.
• Actively manage workflow automation and digitalization initiatives in close collaboration with IT and data teams.
• Ensure that processes comply with applicable regulatory requirements.
• Identify operational pain points and drive problem-solving and process optimization initiatives.
• Act as a central coordination point between operational teams, IT, Finance, and external partners.
• Foster collaboration and ensure seamless coordination across teams to address operational challenges.
• Ensure the timely implementation of IT solutions with our partners and proactively remove any delivery blockers.
• Contribute to the implementation or enhancement of tools and systems supporting operational management.
• Identify opportunities for operational improvement and lead process optimization projects.

What we expect

• Master's degree (or equivalent, Bac+5) in Management, Engineering, Finance, Insurance, or a related field
• At least 5 years of experience in a cross-functional role, with exposure to operational processes, technology, finance, data management, and business operations
• Proven experience in an international and/or multi-country environment is highly desirable
• Strong organizational, problem-solving and analytical skills, with a continuous improvement mindset
• Proven ability to thrive in complex, multicultural environments, ideally within agile or fast-growing organizations.
• Fluency in English (working language); additional European languages (French, German, Spanish) are an asset
• SQL language proficiency

About Baloise

We are more than a traditional insurance company: we are the personal partner for everyone who wants to feel simply safe. In addition to our traditional financial business, we are also broadening our range with ecosystems in the areas of mobility and home. We see the digital age as an opportunity to make our offering even more sustainable, innovative and customer-oriented in the future. Are you shaping it with us?

We give you the freedom to pursue your ideas. Get involved! Question us! Develop yourself and us even further! Our culture of learning and making mistakes as well as communication at eye level all make this possible. Because only together can we move forward.

title: Software Development Engineer (ML), EU International Technologies (m/f)
description:
Software Development Engineer (ML), EU International Technologies
Job ID: 10566721 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

As an engineer on our team, you will take on a key role in improving capabilities of the Amazon product search service, and ensure we offer top-quality recommendations for all our customers regardless of their location or language. We help customers find the products they are searching for, and discover new products they would be interested in, by developing ML models trained on terabytes of product and traffic data to improve query understanding, ranking of search results, and personalization. We are seeking a software engineer who will assist in deploying those ML models, integrating them into existing services, and optimizing their performance. You will do so by building robust pipelines to train, evaluate, and deploy our models.

This is a rewarding role where you will be able to draw a clear connection between your work and how it improves the experience of millions of Amazon customers across the globe every day. You can also expect to have excellent opportunities, and ample support, for career growth, development, and mentorship. The team is a mixed science/engineering group, with each team member able to contribute to both engineering excellence as well as scientific innovation.

Key job responsibilities

- Design and implement new features across the various software components powering our search system
- Participate in the design and deployment of robust and scalable pipelines for data processing, model training, and model inference
- Build and configure metrics, dashboards, and alerting mechanisms for our deployed services and models
- Work closely with ML experts on your team to identify improvement opportunities and tackle technical obstacles
- Coordinate with engineering counterparts in other teams and stakeholders we work with

A day in the life

You will collaborate with scientists who build ML models trained on terabytes of data, and integrate these models into the production search engine that serves customers, closing the loop through design, implementation, deployment, and monitoring. The chosen approaches for model architecture will balance business-defined performance metrics with the needs of millisecond response times.

About the team

EU International Technologies is an organization focused on accelerating the EU Stores business by delighting customers and selling partners. The team's mission is to innovate locally and scale worldwide, fostering a world-class community of builders that delivers with speed and agility. EU INTech operates across domains including consumer discovery, search, selection, partner growth, pricing, sustainability, and marketplace expansion. The culture emphasizes collaboration, inclusion, technical excellence, big bets on high-impact projects, transparency, and long-term ownership -- empowering engineers and scientists to solve complex problems at international scale.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related quantitative field
- 3+ years of professional software development experience
- 1+ year of experience in building large-scale pipelines for data processing and ML model training/inference
- Strong coding and problem-solving skills in at least one modern programming language such as Python, Java, C++, etc.
- A general understanding of essential machine learning concepts (with no expectation of in-depth ML knowledge)
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including code reviews, build processes, testing, and deployment

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science or a related quantitative field
- Professional experience with AWS services (e.g. S3, EC2, Lambda, EMR, DynamoDB)
- Prior experience within a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers
- Experience with NLP applications or search/retrieval engines
- Fluency in one or more languages other than English

description:

Description

Opportunities in locations including: the UK, Luxembourg, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, Sweden and the Netherlands. While we will consider location preferences if possible, we ask you to be as location-agnostic as possible since you may receive an offer from any of these corporate locations. Fluency in English is essential for all roles in Europe and local language skills are highly desirable for some positions, but are not essential for every role.

At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.
Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...

• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.
• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.

title: Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (h/f)
description:
Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F) – Région Liège-Luxembourg

Reference: LU879641
Luxembourg
Permanent
Legal and Professional Services

Notre client est un cabinet de conseil international fondé au début des années 2000 et aujourd'hui présent dans plusieurs pays européens.
Sa mission est d'accompagner les entreprises dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs en délivrant des résultats mesurables et concrets.
Son expertise couvre l'excellence opérationnelle, l'optimisation de la supply chain, la data, la conduite du changement, la transformation digitale et la transition durable.

Le cabinet intervient auprès d'organisations de premier plan dans des secteurs variés tels que l'industrie, les sciences de la vie, le secteur public, les services financiers, le retail et la construction.
Dans un contexte où les transformations numériques s'accélèrent et où les DSI, CIO et CTO jouent un rôle croissant dans la définition de la stratégie des entreprises, notre client souhaite aujourd'hui franchir une nouvelle étape avec la création et le développement d'une practice CIO Advisory.

Cette practice a vocation à devenir un axe majeur du développement du cabinet, en accompagnant les dirigeants IT et les directions générales dans leurs réflexions et transformations stratégiques, organisationnelles et technologiques.
Pour accompagner sa croissance et participer à des projets de transformation et d'excellence opérationnelle, notre client recherche actuellement un(e) Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F).

Votre rôle

En tant que Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory, vous aurez la responsabilité de piloter et délivrer des missions de transformation IT à fort impact, tout en contribuant au développement de la practice, de son portefeuille clients et de ses équipes.
Vous interviendrez directement auprès des CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, de la définition des orientations jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre, avec une forte exigence de résultats, de qualité de delivery et d'impact durable.

Pilotage et delivery des missions clients

Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conduite et la réussite des missions de la practice :

• Piloter des missions complexes de stratégie et transformation IT, de leur cadrage jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre.
• Accompagner les clients dans la définition de leur vision cible IT et sa déclinaison en feuilles de route concrètes et opérationnelles.
• Superviser les diagnostics, analyses, recommandations et plans de transformation réalisés par les équipes.
• Challenger les organisations, processus, architectures et modes de fonctionnement IT afin d'identifier les leviers de performance et de transformation.
• Assurer la qualité des livrables, le respect des engagements et l'atteinte des résultats attendus.
• Intervenir directement auprès des instances de direction et accompagner les clients dans leurs décisions stratégiques.
• Sécuriser l'exécution des transformations et accompagner les équipes clients jusqu'à l'obtention de résultats durables.
Développement et structuration de la practice

En vous appuyant sur les besoins rencontrés sur le terrain, vous contribuerez à faire évoluer et structurer l'offre CIO Advisory :

• Développer des méthodologies et approches permettant de transformer l'expertise acquise en mission en offres structurées et réplicables.
• Identifier les nouvelles problématiques rencontrées par les CIO et faire évoluer l'offre en conséquence.
• Développer des synergies avec les autres expertises du cabinet : cybersécurité, data, ERP, cloud, transformation et excellence opérationnelle.
• Contribuer au positionnement et au développement de la practice au sein de mon client.
Développement commercial et relation client
Le développement commercial s'inscrira dans la continuité de votre activité de conseil et de votre proximité avec les clients :
• Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités à partir des enjeux et besoins rencontrés chez les clients.
• Construire et développer un portefeuille de missions CIO Advisory.
• Piloter les avant-ventes, propositions commerciales, appels d'offres et soutenances.
• Développer le cross-selling avec les autres practices et contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

Leadership et développement des équipes

En tant que Directeur, vous serez également responsable de la qualité et du développement des équipes intervenant sur vos missions :

• Encadrer les équipes et leur apporter le niveau de guidance nécessaire à la réussite des missions.
• Challenger les analyses, recommandations et livrables afin de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence.
• Accompagner les consultants dans leur montée en compétences et leur capacité à prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités en delivery.
• Transmettre votre expertise à travers le coaching, le mentoring et le partage d'expérience.
• Contribuer au recrutement et au développement des expertises nécessaires à la croissance de la practice.
• Développer une culture fondée sur l'excellence du delivery, le pragmatisme, la collaboration et l'obtention de résultats concrets.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons avant tout un leader entrepreneurial, capable de combiner expertise technique, excellence du delivery et développement commercial.

Vous disposez idéalement de :

• Une formation de niveau Master (Bac+5), idéalement issue d'une école d'ingénieurs, d'une université ou d'une grande école avec une spécialisation IT, digitale ou technologique.
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans le conseil, la transformation IT ou des environnements technologiques complexes.
• De solides compétences techniques et une forte compréhension des enjeux IT, vous permettant de challenger des architectures, des organisations, des choix technologiques et des trajectoires de transformation.
• Une expertise sur plusieurs dimensions du CIO Advisory : stratégie IT, operating model, cloud, infrastructures, architecture, cybersécurité, data, modernisation ou rationalisation des systèmes d'information.
• Une expérience significative dans le pilotage et le delivery de missions complexes, depuis le cadrage stratégique jusqu'à la mise en œuvre.
• Une expérience solide auprès de CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, avec la capacité à intervenir comme interlocuteur de confiance sur des problématiques stratégiques et techniques.
• Une réelle capacité à développer du business : identification d'opportunités, développement de comptes, construction de propositions commerciales, soutenances et développement de nouvelles missions.
• Une forte capacité à développer et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des décideurs de haut niveau.
• Un fort esprit entrepreneurial, avec l'envie de construire, structurer et faire grandir une activité.
• Une excellente communication, une forte posture de conseil et une capacité à embarquer clients et équipes.

description:

Level of Experience:  Experienced

Job Description:


Your future team:

The Accounting & Reporting Advisory (ARA) group is a dedicated team of IFRS, US GAAP and LUX GAAP experts that seek to use accounting standards constructively and positively to help clients on complex accounting matters – be it providing expert input and challenge to transactions or providing the assurance that their IFRS, Lux GAAP or US GAAP reporting will stand up to scrutiny.
ARA is a client-facing group that is accustomed to being the expert in the room. ARA is also in charge of dealing with accounting consultations received from the engagement teams of Deloitte. The ARA team members are experts in accounting standards and their practical application to address the challenges faced by clients in different industries.


Your contribution to our success:

The role requires both strong technical and business development capabilities. As a Manager in ARA, you will take ownership of complex client engagements and play a key role in developing the team:

Lead and manage advisory engagements - covering new standards implementation, conversion from one GAAP to another, structured transactions, accounting policy reviews and financial statement reviews - from scoping and planning through delivery and quality review, including presentation of findings and recommendations to senior client management.
Drive the development of the practice by acting as a dynamic “motor” within the team: proactively shaping our service offering, contributing to the growth of the ARA brand and supporting the implementation of our strategic initiatives.
Contribute to business development by building and maintaining client relationships, identifying follow-on opportunities within existing engagements, preparing proposals and contributing to eminence-building initiatives such as internal guidance, technical notes, training sessions and client presentations.
Manage, coach and develop team members, providing on-the-job training, constructive feedback and helping to build a strong technical and client-facing skillset across the team.
Act as the subject matter contact for audit teams and clients on complex accounting transactions, consolidation challenges and financial reporting matters.
Review and challenge technical analysis prepared by senior and junior staff, ensuring robust conclusions and high-quality deliverables under IFRS, Lux GAAP and US GAAP.
Deliver seamless, joined-up expert input alongside other Deloitte teams (e.g. tax, consulting) and proactively identify opportunities for cross-service offerings.


Your skills:

6+ years' experience with IFRS and/or Lux GAAP and/or US GAAP in professional services or corporate accounting policy, ideally in the financial or commercial sector; exposure to consolidated financial statements and complex group structures is a plus.  
Proven ability to lead and review complex IFRS/US GAAP (and preferably Lux GAAP) accounting matters, including drafting and assessing technical memorandums and client deliverables.  
Track record in managing projects and teams: planning engagements, monitoring budgets and timelines, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, and ensuring high-quality client service.  
Strong business acumen and advisory skills, connecting accounting implications to commercial and strategic considerations and identifying value-creation opportunities.  
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to explain complex technical issues to diverse stakeholders and build trusted relationships.  
Chartered Accountant qualification (IRE, DEC, IRE Belge, ACCA, US CPA or equivalent) and commitment to ongoing professional development.  
Fluency in English; French, German or Luxembourgish are an asset.  
Solid understanding of financial or commercial industries and related regulation, plus strong skills in Microsoft Office, analytics tools, and effective use of AI to improve efficiency and deliverable quality.


Interested? Please submit your resume in English.
