Risk Officer - UCITS (m/f)

Fundsight is looking for a Risk Officer to join its UCITS Risk Management team.
In this role, you will be responsible for managing the risk management framework for a portfolio of UCITS clients.

Your role

• Assist the UCITS Risk Management team with the implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework.
• Prepare periodic risk reports on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.
• Perform risk assessments for existing and new UCITS, determine their risk profiles and monitor applicable risk limits, including market risk (commitment and VaR), credit risk, liquidity risk, counterparty risk and operational risk indicators (including TER, PTR and NAV errors).
• Contribute to the integration and monitoring of sustainability risks, including ESG, SFDR and EU Taxonomy considerations, within the risk management process.
• Support the Head of Risk Management on a range of risk management matters.
• Review the existing risk management framework against regulatory and internal requirements, in close cooperation with other departments.
• Monitor UCITS liquidity and analyse the results of liquidity stress tests.
• Provide regular updates to the Head of Risk Management and the relevant governing bodies.

Your skills and experience

• Master's degree in economics, finance, mathematics or a related field.
• At least 2 years of previous experience in risk management, control and/or audit functions.
• Good knowledge and understanding of the Luxembourg investment fund industry and the UCITS regulatory framework.
• Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English; proficiency in French or Italian would be an asset.

Who we are

FundSight is an independent third-party Management Company (ManCo) based in Luxembourg, regulated by the CSSF and holding a dual AIFM and UCITS license as well as a MiFID authorization. Its business has been licensed since 1971 and was carved out and wholly acquired (100%) by BlackFin in 2025; FundSight has since been an independent company, with no operational or capital ties to Lemanik. It has a center of excellence in Porto, a branch in Paris, and representative offices in Hong Kong and Tokyo. The Group is also established in New York and Atlanta. FundSight today supports more than 120 institutional clients and manages more than €40 billion in assets under management. For more information: www.fundsight.com.

Deal Advisory - Valuation Senior Analyst
BDO Luxembourg is looking for Deal Advisory Valuation Senior Analyst!

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing.

At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships.

What will you do?

• Perform valuation engagements for internal and external clients, with a particular focus on alternative investments, including real estate, private equity, private debt and infrastructure
• Conduct valuations of real estate assets, holding companies, and real estate portfolios using appropriate valuation methodologies
• Develop, review and challenge financial models, including Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), market-based approaches and Net Asset Value (NAV)

This position is for you if:

• You have a solid understanding of valuation methodologies and financial modelling techniques, with a particular interest in alternative investments and real estate
• You possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to critically assess financial information and valuation assumptions
• You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and comfortable working with complex financial models; Python and Power BI knowledge are considered an advantage
• You aim to continue learning and developing your technical expertise across different asset classes
• You are proactive, involved, highly motivated and take responsibility for your own work

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

C'est d'abord offrir une qualité de service irréprochable à nos clients. Sales Lentz est une entreprise familiale, fondée en 1948, qui ne cesse de grandir et d'innover. Notre objectif se résume en quelques mots: simplifier la mobilité pour tous.
Notre fil conducteur est, et restera, la pleine et entière satisfaction de nos passagers, quels qu'ils soient.
En tant que chauffeur, vous aurez la responsabilité de clients de tous âges et aux profils variés selon les lignes qui vous seront confiées. Vous pourrez ainsi prendre en charge des enfants ou des personnes à mobilité réduite, avec ou sans handicap.
Vous pourrez également assurer des navettes sur de grands évènements ou même encore effectuer des courses en soirée ou de nuit pour aider nos passagers à rentrer chez eux en toute sécurité. Certains déplacements vous amèneront dans les pays limitrophes.

Nous recherchons de futurs collaborateurs soucieux du bien-être de nos clients, petits et grands. Vous saurez ainsi vous montrer aimable, bienveillant et disponible tout en faisant preuve de patience et de maîtrise de soi.
Bien évidemment, la sécurité de tous est notre priorité. Nous vous demanderons donc de conduire de façon souple et prudente, dans le strict respect du code de la route, mais également de prendre soin de votre véhicule tout autant que de vos passagers. Vous devrez toujours vous assurer du bon état général et de la propreté de votre véhicule, avant, pendant et après vos tournées.

Le métier de chauffeur nécessite une grande flexibilité dans les horaires de travail (y compris la nuit, le week end et les jours fériés).
En contrepartie, vous intégrerez un groupe leader du transport de personnes au Luxembourg, et exercerez un métier passionnant qui vous ouvrira des perspectives d'évolutions concrètes au sein du Groupe SLG (près de 2000 collaborateurs au Luxembourg, en Belgique et en Italie).

Postes en CDI à pourvoir dès que possible à Mersch ou Allerborn

• Être titulaire d'un permis B en cours de validité reconnu dans un pays de l'Union Européenne

Avant de passer à l'étape suivante, pensez à vous munir des documents suivants afin de pouvoir valider votre candidature:

title: Depositary Specialist (m/f)
description:
The SEI Luxembourg team (“SEI Lux”) is seeking a Depositary Specialist. SEI Lux provides depositary services to Luxembourg domiciled funds ensuring that the funds are managed in compliance with regulatory requirements and funds' constitutional documents.

The Specialist will liaise with Investment Managers, Global Custodians, Prime Brokers, and Administrators on an ongoing basis. The individual must be self-motivated, goal orientated and can manage multiple tasks concurrently and within predetermined deadlines. This position reports to the Head of Depositary and is an opportunity for a suitable candidate to gain exposure to all areas of depositary and fund administration with a leading global service provider.

This position may be eligible to be performed in a hybrid fashion (in the office 3 or more days/week, and from a home office up to 2 days/week), within any applicable tax and social security limits for cross-border work.

What you will do:

The candidate will be required to work both independently and as part of a team to ensure that SEI and its clients are in full compliance with regulatory requirements.  Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

• Prepare compliance and NAV reviews in accordance with the Depositary's policies and procedures.
• Perform and review cash-flow monitoring
• Perform asset verification checks
• Liaise with the global sub-custodians, administrator and prime brokers, as required  
• Meet deliverables and deadlines
• Participate in new fund launches
• Participate in annual due diligence oversight program of administrators, sub-custodians and AIFM and UCI managers
• Participate in internal audit reviews
• Ad-hoc tasks / projects as required
• Develop and maintain strong business relationship with colleagues
• Assist with training and development of analysts within the team
• Work collaboratively with colleagues within our Group

What we need from you:

• 5+ years' experience with depositary services in alternative investments/hedge funds, ideally with private equity/private debt
• Ability to independently manage multiple projects and deadlines to meet strict deadlines, prioritizing work and maximizing efficiencies to manage time
• Business Fluency in English
• P.C. proficiency, particularly with Microsoft Excel and Word.

What we would like from you:

• Third level qualification, preferably in Finance or related field
• Proven Oversight skills, including experience overseeing and monitoring delegates.
• Project management experience, including strong organizational and administrative skills
• Knowledge of Anti-Money Laundering requirements
• Initiative and ownership of assigned deliverables and responsibilities
• Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
• Keen critical thinking, analysis and problem solving skills
• Fluency in foreign language (both written and verbal) an advantage
• Someone who will embody our SEI Values of courage, integrity, collaboration, inclusion, connection and fun.  Please see our website for more information.  https://www.seic.com/

About SEI® & SEI Lux:

SEI (NASDAQ:SEIC) delivers technology and investment solutions that connect the financial services industry. With capabilities across investment processing, operations, and asset management, SEI works with corporations, financial institutions and professionals, and ultra-high-net-worth families to help drive growth, make confident decisions, and protect futures. As of June 30, 2023, SEI manages, advises, or administers approximately $1.3 trillion in assets. For more information, visit seic.com.

SEI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and so much more:

SEI is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We recognize that our people are our most valuable asset and are (literally) invested in your success we know that a healthy, happy and motivated workforce is key to our continued growth. We are focused on ensuring a healthy work-life balance.
We are a technology and asset management company, delivering on our promise of building brave futuresSM—for our clients, our communities, and ourselves. Come build your brave future at SEI.

title: RESEARCH ENGINEER IN ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE PLASMA DEPOSITION OF FUNCTIONAL COATINGS m/f
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST E.P.
description:
Description:

RESEARCH ENGINEER IN ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE PLASMA DEPOSITION OF FUNCTIONAL COATINGS

Fixed term contract | Belval | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

• Within European collaborative research and innovation projects, the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is seeking a Research Engineer in Atmospheric-Pressure Plasma Deposition of Functional Coatings. Working with universities, research institutes, and industrial partners across Europe, you will help develop high-performance, multifunctional materials and surfaces for applications ranging from fluid-dynamic surfaces to textile finishing. Your mission and contributions are:
• To conduct applied research work on atmospheric pressure plasma deposition of functional materials.
• To optimise atmospheric-pressure plasma deposition processes for functional coatings (e.g. barrier, hydrophobic, antimicrobial, or protective layers) on textured, porous, or flexible substrates.
• To scale up and transfer processes from laboratory to pilot level, including continuous (e.g. roll-to-roll) configurations, in close collaboration with industrial partners.
• To characterize the deposited materials using various surface analytical techniques, together with functional performance testing adapted to project requirements.
• To contribute to the preparation of scientific reports, publications, and presentations.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

A PhD (or equivalent experience) in materials science, plasma science, chemistry, or on textile science and technology, with a strong focus on finishing/functionalization.

Experience and skills

• 3 to 5 years of proven experience in an international R&D environment (public or private sector).
• Demonstrated experience in atmospheric-pressure plasma deposition (e.g. DBD, plasma jets, plasma-enhanced CVD, plasma polymerisation, aerosol-assisted plasma deposition), including reactor setup, pilot or semi-pilot operation, and process implementation for functional thin films and coatings.
• Ability to evaluate and optimise key process parameters, including power and frequency, gas composition and flow, precursor delivery (vapour or aerosol), electrode gap, and substrate temperature and speed.
• Proven autonomy in surface characterization techniques, such as SEM, AFM, XPS, FTIR, ellipsometry, contact angle measurements, and functional performance testing.
• Strong awareness of laboratory and process safety, including high-voltage and RF equipment, handling reactive precursors, and management of by-products.
• You are committed to a strong data security and confidentiality, with experience in handling sensitive information according to consortium agreements.
• You have ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced international consortium environment.

Language skills

• Fluency in English, both oral and written.
• Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:

•          A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
•          A scientific CV with contact details
•          List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
•          Contact details of 2 references

Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions
In accordance with Article L 252-1 of the Luxembourg Labour Code and the requirements of European Defence Agency funding, this position is open exclusively to nationals of the European Union Member States. While we maintain a commitment to equal opportunities and non-discrimination, this restriction applies due to the defence and strategic nature of this EDA-funded research initiative.

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin (knowing the EDA constraints), race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.

As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.

This position offers a gross monthly salary between €6094 and €6678, paid over 13 months (€79.222–€86.814 annually) based on full time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience.
For part time employment, the salary is adjusted pro rata.

Luxembourg | Permanent Contract | Hybrid Working | International Environment

Take the lead in driving demand generation for a growing European group!

Our client is an established European group specialising in digital infrastructure and data centres, with a strong presence across key Northern European markets.
Operating in a sector driven by cloud computing, artificial intelligence and digital sovereignty, the group is accelerating its growth and strengthening its commercial and marketing strategy.
The ambition? To turn demand generation into a powerful driver of business growth.

Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, you will take ownership of B2B demand generation across several European markets.
As the key marketing expert within your scope, you will work independently while collaborating closely with international Sales and Operations teams.

Define the Go-to-Market strategy: identify priority markets, customer segments and target accounts, tailoring positioning and messaging to each market.

Collaborate internationally: support Sales teams, coordinate customer events and contribute to the group's strategic discussions.

You ideally bring 5 to 8 years of experience in Demand Generation, Growth Marketing or Marketing Operations, within a B2B technology environment.
You have strong hands-on expertise in digital acquisition, tracking, analytics, CRM and marketing automation. You are equally comfortable developing a strategy, implementing it and measuring its impact.
Independent, analytical and results-driven, you thrive in complex environments, enjoy taking ownership and bring an entrepreneurial approach to your work.
You actively explore emerging technologies and know how to leverage AI to develop smarter, more effective marketing approaches.
Minimum C1 level in English required.

Your Profile:

• Minimum 7 years of experience within the banking and financial services industry, including significant exposure to the Luxembourg fund industry.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Audit, Law, or a related field.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French and/or German would be considered a strong asset. Any additional language will be viewed favourably.

You possess excellent knowledge of:

• AIFMD and the Luxembourg regulatory framework applicable to investment funds.

You have a strong understanding of:

Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

title: PHD POSITION IN ADVANCED CORRELATIVE MICROSCOPY (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Description de tâches:


SD-25168 - PHD POSITION IN ADVANCED CORRELATIVE MICROSCOPY AND ISOTOPIC IMAGING FOR NEXT-GENERATION LI-ION BATTERIES

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | up to 48 months (14 months initial contract)

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us.

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies, LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.


How will you contribute?

The PhD project will focus on the development of advanced correlative microscopy and isotopic imaging methodologies to investigate lithium transport and interfacial processes in next-generation silicon-based Li-ion battery electrodes.
The candidate will contribute to the development of high-throughput FIB-SIMS workflows, building on methodologies previously developed at LIST, and will adapt innovative sample preparation strategies to preserve the complex porous structure and fragile Solid Electrolyte Interphase (SEI).
A major objective of the PhD will be to develop and optimize advanced characterization approaches, including cryogenic sample preparation and analysis, protective capping and lift-out strategies, and automated high-resolution isotopic mapping.
The candidate will also contribute to the development of automated acquisition and data-processing workflows, enabling large-area, statistically representative 2D and 3D maps of lithium isotopes and SEI-related species.
These datasets will provide quantitative information on lithium distribution and transport at the nanoscale and serve as inputs for predictive modelling of battery behaviour.
The doctoral researcher will work closely with experienced scientists, engineers and international project partners in a highly interdisciplinary environment combining battery science, nano-analytics, instrumentation, software development and data science.
The position offers the opportunity to gain expertise in cutting-edge FIB-SIMS and correlative microscopy, electrochemical materials characterization, isotopic tracing, automated data analysis and scientific communication.
The candidate will take an active role in designing and performing experiments, developing analytical methodologies, interpreting results, publishing scientific findings and presenting the work at international conferences.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!


Education:

• Master's degree in Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, Engineering, or a closely related field.
• Interest in working with advanced and prototype scientific instruments.
• Basic programming skills (e.g. Python) and an interest in developing automated data analysis and acquisition workflows are considered an asset.
• Self-motivated, with a strong interest in science and research.
• Excellent team spirit and ability to work in a multidisciplinary and international environment.


Language skills:

• Fluency in English, both oral and written.
• Other relevant languages are an asset.


Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects.
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society.
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do.
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas.
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills.
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce.
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions.
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science.
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance.
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers.


Apply online

Your application must include:

• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience.
• A scientific CV with contact details.
• Contact details of 2 references.

Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.


Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce.
This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Higher Education & Careers Counsellor full-time (m/f)
description:
Description de tâches:


Want to help students shape what comes next?

At XXXX, we want every student to leave us with the self-knowledge, skills and confidence to make thoughtful choices about their future.

We are looking for an experienced Higher Education & Careers Counsellor to guide students in Grades 9–12 as they explore universities, careers and other post-secondary pathways around the world. You will help students connect their interests, strengths, values and learning experiences with future possibilities—developing the agency to make choices that are meaningful to them.
Working within our international and IB learning environment, you will help students connect the IB Learner Profile, Approaches to Learning (ATL) skills and their academic and wider experiences with life beyond XXXX. You will also guide students and families in understanding our three pathways: the full IB Diploma Programme, IB Courses and Global Impact Diploma (GID).


What will you do?

You will build trusting relationships with students and families and provide personalised, internationally minded guidance throughout the future-planning process.

• Coach students to reflect on their strengths, interests and aspirations and take ownership of their future choices.
• Deliver a coherent Higher Education & Careers programme across Grades 9–12, including individual and small-group guidance.
• Help students research and evaluate universities and other post-secondary opportunities around the world, alongside vocational education, gap experiences, entrepreneurship and employment.
• Guide students and families through international university admissions, with particular expertise in the US college and university application process.
• Support applications, including essays and personal statements, CVs/résumés, portfolios, interviews, recommendations and deadlines.
• Help students articulate who they are as learners and contributors by connecting their academic learning, IB Learner Profile attributes, ATL skills, CAS and community engagement with their future aspirations.

• The ability to work effectively within a culturally and linguistically diverse international community.

• Excellent written and spoken English.
• Professional discretion, sound ethical judgement and a strong commitment to safeguarding.


Valued experience

• Within an IB World School and with pathways beyond the full IB Diploma.
• Supporting applications across multiple countries and higher education systems.
• Working with platforms such as Unifrog, UCAS, Common Application and Studielink.
• Coordinating university fairs, admissions events or career-related learning.
• Supporting experiential, service or impact-based programmes such as the Global Impact Diploma.
• Supporting multilingual learners and students with diverse learning needs.
• Using French and/or German.
• Membership or qualifications in higher education, university admissions or careers counselling.


You'll thrive in this role if you...

...are a relationship builder and thoughtful listener who creates space for students to talk openly about their aspirations and uncertainties.
...believe in student agency and use coaching, questioning and reflection to help young people make their own informed decisions.
...are internationally minded, culturally responsive and open-minded, recognising that there is no single pathway or definition of future success.
...are an organised and collaborative professional who can make complex admissions processes understandable while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
...remain curious and reflective, keeping your knowledge current as higher education, careers and the world of work continue to evolve.


Interested in joining our learning community?

At XXXX, future planning is about more than helping students decide where they will go next. It is about helping them understand who they are, what matters to them and how they can contribute.
As our Higher Education & Careers Counsellor, you will help students explore possibilities, navigate choices and develop the skills and confidence to shape their own futures.

Description:

RESEARCH ENGINEER IN ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE PLASMA DEPOSITION OF FUNCTIONAL COATINGS

Fixed term contract | Belval | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

• Within European collaborative research and innovation projects, the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is seeking a Research Engineer in Atmospheric-Pressure Plasma Deposition of Functional Coatings. Working with universities, research institutes, and industrial partners across Europe, you will help develop high-performance, multifunctional materials and surfaces for applications ranging from fluid-dynamic surfaces to textile finishing. Your mission and contributions are:
• To conduct applied research work on atmospheric pressure plasma deposition of functional materials.
• To optimise atmospheric-pressure plasma deposition processes for functional coatings (e.g. barrier, hydrophobic, antimicrobial, or protective layers) on textured, porous, or flexible substrates.
• To scale up and transfer processes from laboratory to pilot level, including continuous (e.g. roll-to-roll) configurations, in close collaboration with industrial partners.
• To characterize the deposited materials using various surface analytical techniques, together with functional performance testing adapted to project requirements.
• To contribute to the preparation of scientific reports, publications, and presentations.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

A PhD (or equivalent experience) in materials science, plasma science, chemistry, or on textile science and technology, with a strong focus on finishing/functionalization.

Experience and skills

• 3 to 5 years of proven experience in an international R&D environment (public or private sector).
• Demonstrated experience in atmospheric-pressure plasma deposition (e.g. DBD, plasma jets, plasma-enhanced CVD, plasma polymerisation, aerosol-assisted plasma deposition), including reactor setup, pilot or semi-pilot operation, and process implementation for functional thin films and coatings.
• Ability to evaluate and optimise key process parameters, including power and frequency, gas composition and flow, precursor delivery (vapour or aerosol), electrode gap, and substrate temperature and speed.
• Proven autonomy in surface characterization techniques, such as SEM, AFM, XPS, FTIR, ellipsometry, contact angle measurements, and functional performance testing.
• Strong awareness of laboratory and process safety, including high-voltage and RF equipment, handling reactive precursors, and management of by-products.
• You are committed to a strong data security and confidentiality, with experience in handling sensitive information according to consortium agreements.
• You have ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced international consortium environment.

Language skills

• Fluency in English, both oral and written.
• Other relevant languages are an asset.

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

•          A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
•          A scientific CV with contact details
•          List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
•          Contact details of 2 references

For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.

title: PHD POSITION IN ADVANCED CORRELATIVE MICROSCOPY (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Description de tâches:


SD-25168 - PHD POSITION IN ADVANCED CORRELATIVE MICROSCOPY AND ISOTOPIC IMAGING FOR NEXT-GENERATION LI-ION BATTERIES

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | up to 48 months (14 months initial contract)

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us.

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies, LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.


How will you contribute?

The PhD project will focus on the development of advanced correlative microscopy and isotopic imaging methodologies to investigate lithium transport and interfacial processes in next-generation silicon-based Li-ion battery electrodes.
The candidate will contribute to the development of high-throughput FIB-SIMS workflows, building on methodologies previously developed at LIST, and will adapt innovative sample preparation strategies to preserve the complex porous structure and fragile Solid Electrolyte Interphase (SEI).
A major objective of the PhD will be to develop and optimize advanced characterization approaches, including cryogenic sample preparation and analysis, protective capping and lift-out strategies, and automated high-resolution isotopic mapping.
The candidate will also contribute to the development of automated acquisition and data-processing workflows, enabling large-area, statistically representative 2D and 3D maps of lithium isotopes and SEI-related species.
These datasets will provide quantitative information on lithium distribution and transport at the nanoscale and serve as inputs for predictive modelling of battery behaviour.
The doctoral researcher will work closely with experienced scientists, engineers and international project partners in a highly interdisciplinary environment combining battery science, nano-analytics, instrumentation, software development and data science.
The position offers the opportunity to gain expertise in cutting-edge FIB-SIMS and correlative microscopy, electrochemical materials characterization, isotopic tracing, automated data analysis and scientific communication.
The candidate will take an active role in designing and performing experiments, developing analytical methodologies, interpreting results, publishing scientific findings and presenting the work at international conferences.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!


Education:

• Master's degree in Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, Engineering, or a closely related field.

• Self-motivated, with a strong interest in science and research.

title: Higher Education & Careers Counsellor full-time (m/f)
description:
Description de tâches:


Want to help students shape what comes next?

At XXXX, we want every student to leave us with the self-knowledge, skills and confidence to make thoughtful choices about their future.

We are looking for an experienced Higher Education & Careers Counsellor to guide students in Grades 9–12 as they explore universities, careers and other post-secondary pathways around the world. You will help students connect their interests, strengths, values and learning experiences with future possibilities—developing the agency to make choices that are meaningful to them.
Working within our international and IB learning environment, you will help students connect the IB Learner Profile, Approaches to Learning (ATL) skills and their academic and wider experiences with life beyond XXXX. You will also guide students and families in understanding our three pathways: the full IB Diploma Programme, IB Courses and Global Impact Diploma (GID).


What will you do?

You will build trusting relationships with students and families and provide personalised, internationally minded guidance throughout the future-planning process.

• Coach students to reflect on their strengths, interests and aspirations and take ownership of their future choices.
• Deliver a coherent Higher Education & Careers programme across Grades 9–12, including individual and small-group guidance.
• Help students research and evaluate universities and other post-secondary opportunities around the world, alongside vocational education, gap experiences, entrepreneurship and employment.
• Guide students and families through international university admissions, with particular expertise in the US college and university application process.
• Support applications, including essays and personal statements, CVs/résumés, portfolios, interviews, recommendations and deadlines.
• Help students articulate who they are as learners and contributors by connecting their academic learning, IB Learner Profile attributes, ATL skills, CAS and community engagement with their future aspirations.
• Build relationships with universities, admissions professionals, alumni, employers and other partners internationally, and coordinate university fairs, visits and information events.
• Collaborate across the Upper School, including with the IB Diploma Programme and Global Impact Diploma teams, to connect academic choices, experiential learning, wellbeing and future pathways.
• Support relevant university admissions testing and maintain accurate, confidential student records.


What will you bring to XXXX?

Essential

• A Master's degree or equivalent in counselling, education, careers guidance or a relevant field.
• 5–8 years of successful experience in higher education/university counselling.
• Strong knowledge of international higher education and admissions systems and the ability to advise students about universities around the world.
• Experience with the IB Diploma Programme and knowledge of the US college and university application process.
• Strong counselling and coaching skills, with the ability to build trusting relationships with adolescents and families.
• Excellent communication, collaboration, organisation and attention to detail.
• The ability to work effectively within a culturally and linguistically diverse international community.
• Strong digital competence and confidence using higher education and careers platforms.
• Excellent written and spoken English.
• Professional discretion, sound ethical judgement and a strong commitment to safeguarding.


Valued experience

• Within an IB World School and with pathways beyond the full IB Diploma.
• Supporting applications across multiple countries and higher education systems.
• Working with platforms such as Unifrog, UCAS, Common Application and Studielink.
• Coordinating university fairs, admissions events or career-related learning.
• Supporting experiential, service or impact-based programmes such as the Global Impact Diploma.
• Supporting multilingual learners and students with diverse learning needs.
• Using French and/or German.
• Membership or qualifications in higher education, university admissions or careers counselling.


You'll thrive in this role if you...

...are a relationship builder and thoughtful listener who creates space for students to talk openly about their aspirations and uncertainties.
...believe in student agency and use coaching, questioning and reflection to help young people make their own informed decisions.
...are internationally minded, culturally responsive and open-minded, recognising that there is no single pathway or definition of future success.
...are an organised and collaborative professional who can make complex admissions processes understandable while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
...remain curious and reflective, keeping your knowledge current as higher education, careers and the world of work continue to evolve.


Interested in joining our learning community?

At XXXX, future planning is about more than helping students decide where they will go next. It is about helping them understand who they are, what matters to them and how they can contribute.
As our Higher Education & Careers Counsellor, you will help students explore possibilities, navigate choices and develop the skills and confidence to shape their own futures.
XXXX is committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment.

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
The Department of Engineering (DoE) is a dynamic, interdisciplinary group engaged in civil, electrical, mechanical engineering and operations research/management, driving forward innovative research and solutions. It also has an internationally leading profile in computational science and engineering. We develop cutting-edge technologies, promoting the sustainable and economical use of resources, and meeting the technological demands of Luxembourg, the Greater Region, and beyond. Nearly all research projects are supported by a network of national and international partnerships, several with public or industrial stakeholders. At the University, the Department cooperates across faculties and with the interdisciplinary centres. In particular, the new interdisciplinary centre focused on complex environmental systems opens up significant opportunities for future collaborations.
The Department of Engineering seeks to hire a Research Support Engineer, with an interdisciplinary background in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, to integrate the Technical Support Unit (TSU). The candidate will work closely with the Technical Support Unit (TSU) Team Leader across all DoE research areas.

Your role
As a Research Support Engineer within the Department of Engineering TSU, you'll have an exciting and diverse job, typically at the intersection of technical support and project management. You'll be involved in research activities but as well support the Department outreach and education missions.

• Laboratory Management: Ensure all laboratory equipment is properly maintained, calibrated, and functioning optimally. Implement and enforce safety protocols to maintain a safe working environment, in collaboration with the FSTM Safety Officers. Oversee that researchers create and maintain accurate lab books

• Work closely with researchers to understand their technical needs, provide advice on technical solutions and facilitate the translation of research questions into technical implementations
• Setup of experimental platforms involving sensors, instrumentation, and physical measurements, support to prototyping, including the involvement in the design, wiring, commissioning, and troubleshooting of systems
• Coordination and supervision of experimental work together with the PIs
• Liaising with companies and experts to guarantee the efficient, timely, and quality supply of services, software, equipment and laboratory consumables
• Good practices in documenting prototypes, procedures, and experimental results
• Ability to read and write technical documents: schematics, protocols, reports

Your profile
• Master's degree in mechanical, electrical engineering, or similar
• Leadership skills, experience as a team coordinator
• At least 7 years of experience in academia, in charge of supervision of experimental tasks: in the fields of mechanical and civil engineering - structures, knowledge in thermodynamics would be considered an asset
• Interest in academic environments and collaborative research is highly valued
• Adaptability and eagerness to learn
• Problem-solving attitude
• Excellent command of English (C1) is required for international communication and documentation. Excellent command of French or German (C1) is mandatory

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure

title: IT Application Expert (m/f/x)
description:
Description de tâches:


For our department Application Management within General Services, we are looking for a (an):

IT Application Expert (m/f/x)

The IT Application Expert plays a crucial role in maintaining and enhancing the effectiveness of our application landscape. This individual serves as a key escalation point for the Service Desk and internal customers, addressing complex application-related support issues. The role involves continuous collaboration with IT stakeholders and vendors to manage application lifecycles, improve support processes, and contribute to IT service management (ITSM) knowledge.


Key responsibilities:

Serve as an advanced support contact for the Service Desk and internal customers, addressing application-related inquiries and issues.
Enhance the ITSM knowledge base with detailed application support processes and user-centric articles.
Oversee the lifecycle management of a designated application portfolio, including road-mapping, licensing, integration, user training, support, and upgrades.
Coordinate and participate in application upgrades, releases, and maintenance activities with internal IT teams and external vendors, including planned interventions outside normal working hours, typically after the last scheduled flight, to minimize operational disruption and ensure service continuity.
Proactively inform and advise business stakeholders on new application functionalities, utilizing established communication channels.
Collaborate with various IT teams and external vendors to define and establish necessary environments for testing and deploying new releases.
Engage in continuous improvement initiatives, developing and maintaining relevant guidelines and best practices.
Support on the creation of Business Impact assessments for the applications.
Participate in IT related projects, contributing expertise and insights.
Provide occasional administrative support within the activity scope, ensuring operational efficiency.
Uphold responsibility for ITIL process adherence and implementation within the domain.


Required profile:


Qualifications:

Possession of a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or an equivalent blend of education and experience in a similar role.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
Methodical approach to analysis and documentation with a keen attention to detail.
Proven reliability and precision in work output.
Exemplary customer service orientation and ability to act as a role model in this capacity.
Proficiency in standard office software applications.
Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
Strong training delivery capabilities, tailored to diverse audiences.
Effective presentation skills.


Technical knowledge:

Ability to troubleshoot complex application issues using application logs, monitoring dashboards, event management tools, alerts, and performance metrics.
Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL to execute queries for data validation, incident investigation, troubleshooting, and reporting.
Understanding of application integrations, APIs (REST/SOAP), middleware, messaging, and data flows between enterprise systems.
Knowledge of networking and authentication concepts relevant to application support, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTPS, firewalls, Active Directory, LDAP, SSO, OAuth, and SAML.
Ability to analyze technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and system dependencies to support root cause analysis and issue resolution.
Software development skills are not required; however, the ability to understand technical concepts, communicate with technical teams and vendors, and participate in technical troubleshooting is essential.


Desired skills:

Ability to work collaboratively and independently within a team-oriented environment.
Eagerness to learn and apply new technologies.
Advanced communication skills, capable of engaging with all organizational levels and external parties.
Familiarity with departmental tools and applications.
Agility and flexibility in responding to new challenges and priorities.
Basic understanding of ITIL Framework principles.
Commitment to delivering results within agreed timeframes and maintaining data confidentiality.
Additional language skills are considered a valuable asset.


The IT Application Support Specialist in Luxair is a pivotal role aimed at enhancing our IT application services throughout our business lines. We are looking for a dedicated professional who demonstrates a passion for technology, a commitment to service excellence, and a deep understanding of application support dynamics. If you are seeking a challenging and rewarding career opportunity, we invite you to apply for this position.

Meet your future team

Join our Talent Attraction and Acquisition team, supporting recruitment across PwC Luxembourg.
Working closely with Talent Acquisition Advisors and Talent Acquisition Partners, you will join a collaborative team where strong coordination makes a real difference. By bringing structure, responsiveness and consistency to our activities, you will help create a smooth recruitment experience for candidates while supporting the team in working effectively with hiring teams and meeting its operational and administrative requirements.

What your role will look like

As a Talent Attraction & Acquisition Coordinator, you will combine hands-on recruitment scheduling with essential administrative responsibilities. You will manage multiple activities and priorities in parallel, ensuring that each step is handled accurately, on time and with the right level of attention.
The role requires someone who can stay one step ahead, take ownership and bring clarity, while maintaining a high standard of service and attention to detail.

You will:

• Coordinate interviews across the firm, from scheduling and invitations to sharing practical information with candidates.
• Manage Talent Acquisition team calendars and coordinate multiple schedules to ensure a smooth and efficient interview process.
• Serve as a reliable point of contact for candidates, providing clear, timely and professional communication throughout interview coordination.
• Manage the validation and follow-up of Talent Attraction and recruitment invoices and expenses.
• Manage ADEM administration, including vacancy declarations, required updates and documentation, ensuring accurate records and compliance with Luxembourg requirements.
• Track and report on key scheduling metrics, including time-to-schedule, rescheduling, no-shows, interviewer availability and bottlenecks.
• Prepare weekly and monthly activity reports and maintain accurate data for key Talent Attraction and Acquisition metrics.
• Support Talent Attraction and Acquisition projects and initiatives, ensuring effective coordination and follow-up.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date process documentation to support consistency, knowledge sharing and business continuity.

Your growth and opportunities

This role offers the opportunity to build a strong foundation in Talent Attraction and Acquisition while gaining exposure to recruitment activities across PwC Luxembourg.
You will develop your expertise in recruitment coordination, administration, stakeholder management and reporting, while building a broader understanding of how an in-house Talent Acquisition function operates.
As you grow into the role, you will have the opportunity to take greater ownership, contribute ideas and improvements, and become a trusted point of reference for the team. The experience you build will provide a strong platform to continue developing within Talent Acquisition and the broader HR environment.

The skills you bring

You are organised, dependable and comfortable managing multiple priorities. You communicate with confidence and professionalism, take ownership of your responsibilities and pay close attention to the details that contribute to a well-coordinated recruitment process.

• 3 to 4 years of experience in an administrative or coordination role.
• A genuine interest in Human Resources and recruitment.
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
• Clear, warm and professional written and spoken communication in a multicultural environment, with fluency in English and French.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to follow up, align expectations and challenge constructively when needed.
• A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and reliability.
• Discretion and integrity when handling confidential candidate and employee information.

Ways of working

• You contribute actively to the team, build trusted relationships and understand how your work supports shared outcomes.
• You communicate with care and professionalism, adapt to different stakeholders and remain solution-focused when priorities evolve.
• You follow through on commitments, work collaboratively and handle sensitive information with discretion and integrity.

Additional skills that would support your success

• Portuguese language skills would be considered an asset.
• Previous exposure to recruitment, HR coordination or a similar environment would be an advantage.
• Confidence working with HR or recruitment systems and digital tools.
• Good command of Microsoft Excel and an interest in data and reporting.

The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.

Take your next step

Bring your organisation, communication skills and sense of service to a role where your contribution is visible and valued. You will have the opportunity to build strong recruitment expertise, take increasing ownership and become a trusted part of the Talent Attraction and Acquisition team.

If you are looking for a role where great coordination, strong relationships and attention to detail are genuinely valued, we would be happy to hear from you.

Optional Skills

Accepting Feedback, Active Listening, AI Fluency, AI-Human Collaboration, Applicant Tracking System, Behavioral Interviewing, Campus Placement, Candidate Management, Candidate Selection, Candidate Sourcing, Communication, Contract Negotiation, Digital Tooling, Direct Recruiting, Emotional Regulation, Empathy, Employee Referral Programs, End-to-End Recruitment, Escalation Management, Faculty Relations, Hiring Management, Hiring Manager Liaison, Inclusion, Intake Interviews {+ 28 more}

time type Full time

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Joining our team as a Senior Tax Advisor means taking on a pivotal role within a dynamic and fast-paced advisory environment, where technical excellence and high-quality client service are at the core of everything we do.
You will operate in a stimulating and demanding consulting environment where excellence, ownership and continuous development are expected.

You will lead complex assignments aligned with our clients' strategic priorities, bringing technical expertise and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. As a key point of contact for both clients and junior team members, you will contribute to high-quality deliverables while ensuring deadlines and expectations are consistently met.

You will play an active role in client interactions, developing strong relationships, understanding their challenges and providing tailored, value-added advice. Beyond client work, you will play an important role in the development of our team. You will coach and mentor junior team members, review their work and contribute to fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture. Your experience and leadership will help shape both individual careers and the continued growth of our practice.

In return, we offer a stimulating and intellectually challenging environment that encourages initiative and provides genuine opportunities for career progression. Through ongoing training, exposure to complex international projects and increasing leadership responsibilities, you will be empowered to continuously develop your expertise and advance your professional ambitions.

Responsibilities:

As part of our International Tax team, you will take on a central role in delivering high-quality advisory services within a dynamic and client-driven environment.

Your role will include:

• Advising clients on complex International and Luxembourg tax matters, ensuring technical accuracy and relevance in a constantly evolving regulatory landscape;
• Leading and reviewing in-depth tax analysis, and translating technical findings into clear, strategic and actionable recommendations;
• Managing client engagements, including planning, execution and timely delivery of high-quality outputs;
• Acting as a potential point of contact for clients, starting building trusted relationships with the aim of ensuring  full client satisfaction;
• Supervising, mentoring and reviewing the work of junior team members, fostering their development and ensuring quality standards;
• Contributing indirectly to business development initiatives, including proposals and pitches with the support of a highly experienced advisory team ;
• Collaborating closely with  your management team and actively contributing to the growth and positioning of your service line.
You will be expected to demonstrate high dedication to work, a high level of rigor in all aspects of your work and substantial capacity to share your knowledge with your team members.

Your Profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting or Law (with a specialization in Tax Law);
• 2-4 years of relevant experience in International Tax, preferably within a consulting or professional services firm;
• Strong technical expertise in International and Luxembourg tax frameworks;
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and simplify complex matters;
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under pressure;
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with first experiences in client interactions;
• Demonstrated ability to supervise and coach junior team members;
• Proactive, results-driven and committed to continuous learning and professional growth;
• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken).

What We Offer

• A high-impact role with increased autonomy, responsibility and potential client exposure depending on your skills and behavior;
• A key learning process over the long term in business developments initiatives;
• The opportunity to work on complex, technical and strategic assignments;
• A clear career path with leadership development opportunities;
• Continuous learning tailored to your level of experience and ambitions;
• A human-sized international group combining proximity, entrepreneurial spirit and global reach;
• A dynamic, collaborative and high-performing environment where excellence and teamwork go hand in hand.

Forvis Mazars is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which each individual feels welcomed.

Daria Manoilenko

Everyone's story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

Risk Analytics Lead (m/f/d)

title: Financial Crime Compliance Officer (m/f)
employer: Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services & Banking (Luxembourg) S.A.
description:
Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services and Banking (Luxembourg) S.A. (MIBL) is a Bank incorporated in Luxembourg and is fully owned by Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation, member of   the    Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, one of the largest financial groups worldwide.

MIBL provides a wide range of financial services to institutional investors including depositary, custody, fund administration, and other banking-related services.

MIBL now has an opening in its Compliance Department for a:

Financial Crime Compliance Officer                                                                                                                                                                                                         (CDI)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (Ref: MIBLFCCO_092026)

About the Role:

The focus on documented testing, remediation tracking, and assessment of first-line controls reflects current Luxembourg monitoring roles, where the Bank specifically seek experience in second-line testing and assessment of control effectiveness.

Responsibilities:

• Execute scheduled Financial Crime Compliance monitoring reviews in accordance with the approved annual Compliance Monitoring Programme.
• Perform sample-based testing of financial crime controls, including areas such as:
 Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC).
 Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD).
 PEP and sanctions screening.
 ongoing monitoring.
 transaction monitoring/KYT.
 high-risk customers and relationships.
 periodic reviews.
 suspicious activity escalation and reporting processes, where applicable.
• Assess whether controls have been performed in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
• Document testing performed, evidence reviewed and conclusions reached in accordance with established monitoring methodology.
• Identify control weaknesses, exceptions and potential compliance deficiencies and escalate them to senior team members.
• Assist in performing root-cause analysis of identified issues.
• Support the preparation of monitoring reports, including factual findings and supporting evidence.
• Maintain monitoring files and supporting documentation to an appropriate audit and regulatory standard.
• Track agreed remediation actions and follow up with relevant stakeholders on outstanding items.
• Support the production of statistics, KPIs and KRIs.
• Assist with thematic reviews and ad-hoc monitoring exercises arising from emerging risks or regulatory developments.
• Maintain awareness of relevant Luxembourg and EU financial crime regulatory developments.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of monitoring procedures, testing scripts, and working papers.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or master's degree in law, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
• Ideally 1–3 years of relevant experience within Compliance, AML/CFT, Financial Crime, Internal Control, Risk or Audit in the financial services sector. A strong graduate profile with relevant internships may also be considered depending on the organisation.
• Fluency in English.

Required Skills:

• Basic to good understanding of financial crime risks.
• Familiarity with Luxembourg AML/CFT requirements and the CSSF regulatory environment.
• Understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD and sanctions concepts.
• Strong analytical and investigative skills.
• Ability to review evidence critically rather than relying solely on process confirmation.

Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services and Banking (Luxembourg) S.A. (MIBL) is a Bank incorporated in Luxembourg and is fully owned by Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation, member of   the    Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, one of the largest financial groups worldwide.

MIBL provides a wide range of financial services to institutional investors including depositary, custody, fund administration, and other banking-related services.

MIBL now has an opening in its Compliance Department for a:

                                                                                                                                                                                            
Senior Financial Crime Compliance Officer (CDI)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   (Ref:MIBLSFCCO_092026)

About the Role

The role focuses on coordinating the collection, consolidation, and analysis of compliance information, performing oversight reviews, assessing compliance governance arrangements, and supporting the implementation and maintenance of effective compliance and reporting frameworks across the organization.

Responsibilities

• Coordinate the collection, consolidation and analysis of compliance information received from affiliated entities and internal stakeholders for governance, oversight, and reporting purposes.
• Perform oversight reviews to assess compliance with group policies, regulatory requirements, internal standards, and governance frameworks.
• Review periodic compliance reports, key risk indicators, incidents, breaches, complaints, regulatory developments, and remediation actions to identify trends, emerging risks and areas requiring escalation.
• Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of compliance governance arrangements, policies, procedures, and internal control frameworks.
• Conduct thematic reviews and targeted assessments covering governance, conduct, regulatory compliance, outsourcing oversight, conflicts of interest, regulatory reporting, and related compliance risk areas.
• Support the implementation and maintenance of an effective information collection, escalation, and reporting framework across the organization.
• Evaluate whether identified findings represent isolated issues, recurring deficiencies or broader governance and control weaknesses.
• Ensure timely escalation of material issues, overdue actions, and significant compliance matters.
• Review and challenge information submitted by stakeholders to ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
• Support the implementation of regulatory change initiatives and assess the impact of new regulatory requirements on the compliance framework.
• Assist in maintaining governance documentation, compliance inventories, registers, frameworks, and oversight records.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening compliance oversight, transparency, reporting quality and regulatory readiness.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Required Skills

• Typically, 4–5+ years of relevant experience in Compliance Monitoring, Internal Audit, Risk, or a comparable control function within financial services, including demonstrable experience performing independent monitoring or control testing.
• Knowledge of Luxembourg and EU regulatory requirements and supervisory expectations including on CRD/CRR, Outsourcing, ICAAP/ILAAP, Financial Crime, PSR/PSD.
• Experience supporting multi-entity governance models, cross-border oversight, or consolidated compliance frameworks.
• Sound judgement when determining the materiality and severity of findings.
• Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively and independently.
• Strong report-writing and senior stakeholder communication skills.
• High standards of integrity, independence, and professional judgement.
• Fluency in English.

Benefits

- Snacks and fruit provided at the workplace

title: Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) – Umzug nach Malta ( Umzugspaket inklusive ) (Berufsspezialist/in - Vertrieb)
description:

Diese Position wird in Vollzeit angeboten und erfordert flexible Arbeitszeiten. Um dem vollen Sportkalender gerecht zu werden, arbeitest du im Schichtsystem an fünf von sieben Tagen – Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit ist regelmäßig vorgesehen.

Die Stelle ist Teil eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells – du arbeitest sowohl von zu Hause als auch im modernen Büro im Zentrum von Sliema, mit Meerblick und Zugang zu zahlreichen Freizeitmöglichkeiten.

Was wir bieten

- Vollständiges Umzugspaket (Details unten)
- Attraktives Jahresbruttogehalt von ca. 34.600 €
- Gehaltszuschläge abhängig von Arbeitszeiten
- Lebens- und Krankenversicherung
- Kostenlose Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft
- Zusätzliche 5 % deines Bruttojahresgehalts als Altersvorsorge
- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (Homeoffice + Büro)
- Umfassende Einarbeitung und kontinuierliches Coaching
- Interne Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten

Relocation-Paket

- 6 Wochen kostenlose Unterkunft bei Ankunft
- Rückerstattung des Flugtickets (bis zu 285 €)
- 800 € monatlicher Wohnzuschuss in den ersten 6 Monaten
- Zusätzlich 100 € monatlich in den ersten 6 Monaten für Heimflüge

Deine Aufgaben

- Kundenbetreuung via Live-Chat und E-Mail
- Bearbeitung von Anfragen zu Zahlungen, Verifizierung, technischen Themen und allgemeinen Kontofragen
- Eskalation komplexer Fälle an Fachabteilungen
- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur effizienten Problemlösung

Was du mitbringst

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse
- Gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)
- Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung
- Lösungsorientiertes Denken
- Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, inklusive Wochenenden
